quotes.quote: Maybe everyone can live beyond what they're capable of.
quotes.author: Markus Zusak,  I Am the Messenger

quotes.quote: A simple life is good with me. I don't need a whole lot. For me, a T-shirt, a pair of shorts, barefoot on a beach and I'm happy.
quotes.author: Yanni

quotes.quote: You couldn't relive your life, skipping the awful parts, without losing what made it worthwhile. You had to accept it as a whole--like the world, or the person you loved.
quotes.author: Stewart O'Nan,  The Odds: A Love Story

quotes.quote: Was it hard?"I ask.Letting go?"Not as hard as holding on to something that wasn't real.
quotes.author: Lisa Schroeder

quotes.quote: If you are not too long, I will wait here for you all my life.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: To say goodbye is to die a little.
quotes.author: Raymond Chandler,  The Long Goodbye

quotes.quote: Being a mom is what life is about. I hope people realize what the priorities in life should be and know not everything has to be perfect.
quotes.author: Kourtney Kardashian

quotes.quote: If you could choose one characteristic that would get you through life, choose a sense of humor.
quotes.author: Jennifer Jones

quotes.quote: Being in control of your life and having realistic expectations about your day-to-day challenges are the keys to stress management, which is perhaps the most important ingredient to living a happy, healthy and rewarding life.
quotes.author: Marilu Henner

quotes.quote: Biology gives you a brain. Life turns it into a mind.
quotes.author: Jeffrey Eugenides,  Middlesex

quotes.quote: The purpose of human life is to serve, and to show compassion and the will to help others.
quotes.author: Albert Schweitzer

quotes.quote: Life shrinks or expands in proportion to one's courage.
quotes.author: AnaÃ¯s Nin

quotes.quote: You grow up a bit damaged or broken then you have some success but you don't know how to feel good about the work you're doing or the life you're leading.
quotes.author: Johnny Depp

quotes.quote: We are all serving a life sentence, and good behavior is our only hope for a pardon.
quotes.author: Douglas Horton

quotes.quote: Trust is the glue of life. It's the most essential ingredient in effective communication. It's the foundational principle that holds all relationships.
quotes.author: Stephen Covey

quotes.quote: Even death has a heart.
quotes.author: Markus Zusak,  The Book Thief

quotes.quote: Being kind is the most important thing I've ever been taught. That's what my parents always told me - more important than ambition or success is being kind to people. The cornerstone of my life. What I aspire to is to be kind.
quotes.author: Rafe Spall

quotes.quote: Liza, I love you more than any words can say. You have made me a complete person. You are everything to me. And I cannot think of living life without you. And I love you forever.
quotes.author: David Gest

quotes.quote: Don't try to make life a mathematics problem with yourself in the center and everything coming out equal. When you're good, bad things can still happen. And if you're bad, you can still be lucky.
quotes.author: Barbara Kingsolver,  The Poisonwood Bible

quotes.quote: I never read the life of any important person without discovering that he knew more and could do more than I could ever hope to know or do in half a dozen lifetimes.
quotes.author: J. B. Priestley

quotes.quote: Every day is a new opportunity. You can build on yesterday's success or put its failures behind and start over again. That's the way life is, with a new game every day, and that's the way baseball is.
quotes.author: Bob Feller

quotes.quote: Death is not the greatest loss in life. The greatest loss is what dies inside us while we live.
quotes.author: Norman Cousins

quotes.quote: We can never judge the lives of others, because each person knows only their own pain and renunciation. It's one thing to feel that you are on the right path, but it's another to think that yours is the only path.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho

quotes.quote: The saddest people I've ever met in life are the ones who don't care deeply about anything at all. Passion and satisfaction go hand in hand, and without them, any happiness is only temporary, because there's nothing to make it last.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  Dear John

quotes.quote: Life is the most exciting opportunity we have. But we have one shot. You graduate from college once, and that's it. You're going out of that nest. And you have to find that courage that's deep, deep, deep in there. Every step of the way.
quotes.author: Andrew Shue

quotes.quote: No one knows for certain how much impact they have on the lives of other people. Oftentimes, we have no clue. Yet we push it just the same.
quotes.author: Jay Asher,  Thirteen Reasons Why

quotes.quote: It was my father who taught me to value myself. He told me that I was uncommonly beautiful and that I was the most precious thing in his life.
quotes.author: Dawn French

quotes.quote: Love is the crowning grace of humanity, the holiest right of the soul, the golden link which binds us to duty and truth, the redeeming principle that chiefly reconciles the heart to life, and is prophetic of eternal good.
quotes.author: Petrarch

quotes.quote: The art of living is more like wrestling than dancing.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: No persons are more frequently wrong, than those who will not admit they are wrong.
quotes.author: FranÃ§ois de La Rochefoucauld

quotes.quote: People equate success with youth. And if you haven't had a certain amount of success by a certain time in your life, it's never going to happen. There's a fear about that. So people start lying about their age really young. I've never done that because I think it's so insignificant.
quotes.author: Jennifer Jason Leigh

quotes.quote: Did I offer peace today? Did I bring a smile to someone's face? Did I say words of healing? Did I let go of my anger and resentment? Did I forgive? Did I love? These are the real questions. I must trust that the little bit of love that I sow now will bear many fruits, here in this world and the life to come.
quotes.author: Henri Nouwen

quotes.quote: You will find that it is necessary to let things go; simply for the reason that they are heavy. So let them go, let go of them. I tie no weights to my ankles.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: I think there's just one kind of folks. Folks.
quotes.author: Harper Lee,  To Kill a Mockingbird

quotes.quote: The more you praise and celebrate your life, the more there is in life to celebrate.
quotes.author: Oprah Winfrey

quotes.quote: I can imagine no more comfortable frame of mind for the conduct of life than a humorous resignation.
quotes.author: W. Somerset Maugham

quotes.quote: If you have no confidence in self, you are twice defeated in the race of life.
quotes.author: Marcus Garvey

quotes.quote: If you don't like me, life goes on, you know what I mean? But I hope you do like me. Because I think that in addition to being pushy, I'm nice.
quotes.author: Christine Quinn

quotes.quote: Life began with waking up and loving my mother's face.
quotes.author: George Eliot

quotes.quote: The work of art, just like any fragment of human life considered in its deepest meaning, seems to me devoid of value if it does not offer the hardness, the rigidity, the regularity, the luster on every interior and exterior facet, of the crystal.
quotes.author: Pope Paul VI

quotes.quote: I'm sure the universe is full of intelligent life. It's just been too intelligent to come here.
quotes.author: Arthur C. Clarke

quotes.quote: Our parents deserve our honor and respect for giving us life itself. Beyond this they almost always made countless sacrifices as they cared for and nurtured us through our infancy and childhood, provided us with the necessities of life, and nursed us through physical illnesses and the emotional stresses of growing up.
quotes.author: Ezra Taft Benson

quotes.quote: No matter how much suffering you went through, you never wanted to let go of those memories.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami

quotes.quote: If the only prayer you ever say in your entire life is thank you, it will be enough.
quotes.author: Meister Eckhart

quotes.quote: The cure for all the ills and wrongs, the cares, the sorrows, and the crimes of humanity, all lie in the one word 'love'. It is the divine vitality that everywhere produces and restores life.
quotes.author: Lydia M. Child

quotes.quote: You yourself, as much as anybody in the entire universe, deserve your love and affection
quotes.author: Gautama Buddha

quotes.quote: We make a living by what we get, but we make a life by what we give.
quotes.author: Winston Churchill

quotes.quote: The past has no power over the present moment.
quotes.author: Eckhart Tolle

quotes.quote: When I see myself on film it makes me smile, I mean making a good living doing what I enjoy is soo much fun. I just hope that everyone has the chance to enjoy life like I do.
quotes.author: Adrienne Barbeau

quotes.quote: Life is not easy for any of us. But what of that? We must have perseverance and above all confidence in ourselves. We must believe that we are gifted for something and that this thing must be attained.
quotes.author: Marie Curie

quotes.quote: We write in ways that, we generally hope, reflect real life, or at least look familiar to humans. And in life, recurring themes are a recurring theme. We never quite conquer a pet vice or a relationship pattern or a communication habit. We're haunted by our particular demons.
quotes.author: Sara Zarr

quotes.quote: People come, people go - they'll drift in and out of your life, almost like characters in a favorite book. When you finally close the cover, the characters have told their story and you start up again with another book, complete with new characters and adventures. Then you find yourself focusing on the new ones, not the ones from the past.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Rescue

quotes.quote: To me, sadness and humor aren't disrelated and humor is the best tool I've had against the sadness in my life.
quotes.author: Mike Mills

quotes.quote: A painter, who finds no satisfaction in mere representation, however artistic, in his longing to express his inner life, cannot but envy the ease with which music, the most non-material of the arts today, achieves this end. He naturally seeks to apply the methods of music to his own art.
quotes.author: Wassily Kandinsky

quotes.quote: One of the advantages of being disorganized is that one is always having surprising discoveries.
quotes.author: A.A. Milne

quotes.quote: There are so many opportunities in life, that the loss of two or three capabilities is not necessarily debilitating. A handicap can give you the opportunity to focus more on art, writing, or music.
quotes.author: Jim Davis

quotes.quote: The more you know who you are, and what you want, the less you let things upset you.
quotes.author: Stephanie Perkins,  Anna and the French Kiss

quotes.quote: In a time of destruction, create something.
quotes.author: Maxine Hong Kingston

quotes.quote: I like flaws. I think they make things interesting.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  The Truth About Forever

quotes.quote: I don't like people who have never fallen or stumbled. Their virtue is lifeless and it isn't of much value. Life hasn't revealed its beauty to them.
quotes.author: Boris Pasternak

quotes.quote: Whenever you read a cancer booklet or website or whatever, they always list depression among the side effects of cancer. But, in fact, depression is not a side effect of cancer. Depression is a side effect of dying.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: I'm not ashamed to be me. More than anyone else I know, I love my life and accept myself. What's wrong with being unique? I am proud of everything that I am and will become.
quotes.author: Johnny Weir

quotes.quote: The world is a dangerous place to live, not because of the people who are evil, but because of the people who don't do anything about it.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: Ask any successful person to look back over the events of his or her life, and chances are there'll be a turning point of one kind or another. It doesn't matter if that success has come on a ball field or in a boardroom, in a research laboratory or on a campaign trail - it can usually be traced to some pivotal moment.
quotes.author: Bill Rancic

quotes.quote: Keep love in your heart. A life without it is like a sunless garden when the flowers are dead.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: When you find your path, you must not be afraid. You need to have sufficient courage to make mistakes. Disappointment, defeat, and despair are the tools God uses to show us the way.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  Brida

quotes.quote: Suffering has been stronger than all other teaching, and has taught me to understand what your heart used to be. I have been bent and broken, but - I hope - into a better shape.
quotes.author: Charles Dickens,  Great Expectations

quotes.quote: Do not take life too seriously. You will never get out of it alive.
quotes.author: Elbert Hubbard

quotes.quote: In life, you have to take the pace that love goes. You don't force it. You just don't force love, you don't force falling in love, you don't force being in love - you just become. I don't know how to say that in English, but you just feel it.
quotes.author: Juan Pablo Galavis

quotes.quote: Laughter, and the broader category of humor, are key elements in helping us go on with our life after a loss.
quotes.author: Allen Klein

quotes.quote: If people refuse to look at you in a new light and they can only see you for what you were, only see you for the mistakes you've made, if they don't realize that you are not your mistakes, then they have to go.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: You can have it all. Just not all at once.
quotes.author: Oprah Winfrey

quotes.quote: I find out a lot about myself by sleeping. Dreams, they are who I am when I'm too tired to be me.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: If the real world were a book, it would never find a publisher. Overlong, detailed to the point of distraction-and ultimately, without a major resolution.
quotes.author: Jasper Fforde,  Something Rotten

quotes.quote: America stands as a beacon of hope and the possibility of a better life - but it is also a nation where nearly 1 in 4 children live in poverty.
quotes.author: Chris Van Hollen

quotes.quote: The best thing to hold onto in life is each other.
quotes.author: Audrey Hepburn

quotes.quote: The arts are not a way to make a living. They are a very human way of making life more bearable. Practicing an art, no matter how well or badly, is a way to make your soul grow, for heaven's sake.
quotes.author: Kurt Vonnegut

quotes.quote: A good traveler has no fixed plans and is not intent on arriving.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.quote: I think that everybody needs four things in life. Everybody needs something to do regardless of age. Everybody needs someone to love. Everybody needs something to hope for, and, of course, everybody needs someone to believe in.
quotes.author: Lou Holtz

quotes.quote: Be happy for this moment. This moment is your life.
quotes.author: Omar Khayyam

quotes.quote: Every one of us is, in the cosmic perspective, precious. If a human disagrees with you, let him live. In a hundred billion galaxies, you will not find another.
quotes.author: Carl Sagan,  Cosmos

quotes.quote: Life is not a matter of holding good cards, but of playing a poor hand well.
quotes.author: Robert Louis Stevenson

quotes.quote: The hope of eternal life is not to be taken up upon slight grounds. It is a subject to be settled between God and your own soul; settled for eternity. A supposed hope, and nothing more, will prove your ruin.
quotes.author: Ellen G. White

quotes.quote: Richard Donner's friendship and guidance showed me that there's more to life than being an actor.
quotes.author: Jeff Cohen

quotes.quote: Love is life. And if you miss love, you miss life.
quotes.author: Leo Buscaglia

quotes.quote: Here's a news flash: No soldier gives his life. That's not the way it works. Most soldiers who make a conscious decision to place themselves in harm's way do it to protect their buddies. They do it because of the bonds of friendship - and it goes so much deeper than friendship.
quotes.author: Eric Massa

quotes.quote: Art and religion first; then philosophy; lastly science. That is the order of the great subjects of life, that's their order of importance.
quotes.author: Muriel Spark

quotes.quote: If you end up with a boring miserable life because you listened to your mom, your dad, your teacher, your priest, or some guy on television telling you how to do your shit, then you deserve it.
quotes.author: Frank Zappa

quotes.quote: Believe that life is worth living and your belief will help create the fact.
quotes.author: William James

quotes.quote: All I tell artists is, 'Do what you love. Never let anybody talk you into changing what your musical idea is just to try to get a hit, because you're chasing your tail that way. It's not going to happen, and if you're successful, you have to do it the rest of your life. Stay true to it and do it for the sake of the art.'
quotes.author: Gloria Estefan

quotes.quote: If there's a single lesson that life teaches us, it's that wishing doesn't make it so.
quotes.author: Lev Grossman,  The Magicians

quotes.quote: There will always be a place for us somewhere, somehow, as long as we see to it that working people fight for everything they have, everything they hope to get, for dignity, equality, democracy, to oppose war and to bring to the world a better life.
quotes.author: Harry Bridges

quotes.quote: As told in Friendship with God, if we simply decided to believe and act as if first, we're all one, and second, life is eternal, it would render virtually everything we've done all our lives pointless.
quotes.author: Neale Donald Walsch

quotes.quote: Live life to the fullest, and focus on the positive.
quotes.author: Matt Cameron

quotes.quote: It's funny how humans can wrap their mind around things and fit them into their version of reality.
quotes.author: Rick Riordan,  The Lightning Thief

quotes.quote: No matter how careful you are, there's going to be the sense you missed something, the collapsed feeling under your skin that you didn't experience it all. There's that fallen heart feeling that you rushed right through the moments where you should've been paying attention.Well, get used to that feeling. That's how your whole life will feel some day.This is all practice.
quotes.author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Invisible Monsters

quotes.quote: He who has a why to live for can bear almost any how.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Life is a series of natural and spontaneous changes. Don't resist them; that only creates sorrow. Let reality be reality. Let things flow naturally forward in whatever way they like.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.quote: The making of friends who are real friends, is the best token we have of a man's success in life.
quotes.author: Edward Everett Hale

quotes.quote: I believe that if life gives you lemons, you should make lemonade... And try to find somebody whose life has given them vodka, and have a party.
quotes.author: Ron White

quotes.quote: In the film world, we can all be heroes. In the real world, where heroism can cost you your life or the life of the ones you love, people aren't so willing to make those sacrifices. When they do, they are set apart from the rest of us.
quotes.author: John Rhys-Davies

quotes.quote: To choose doubt as a philosophy of life is akin to choosing immobility as a means of transportation.
quotes.author: Yann Martel,  Life of Pi

quotes.quote: Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life. Don't be trapped by dogma - which is living with the results of other people's thinking. Don't let the noise of others' opinions drown out your own inner voice. And most important, have the courage to follow your heart and intuition.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.quote: My goal is to be one with the music. I just dedicate my whole life to this art.
quotes.author: Jimi Hendrix

quotes.quote: Letting go means to come to the realization that some people are a part of your history, but not a part of your destiny.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: When we least expect it, life sets us a challenge to test our courage and willingness to change; at such a moment, there is no point in pretending that nothing has happened or in saying that we are not yet ready. The challenge will not wait. Life does not look back. A week is more than enough time for us to decide whether or not to accept our destiny.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  The Devil and Miss Prym

quotes.quote: We do not grow absolutely, chronologically. We grow sometimes in one dimension, and not in another; unevenly. We grow partially. We are relative. We are mature in one realm, childish in another. The past, present, and future mingle and pull us backward, forward, or fix us in the present. We are made up of layers, cells, constellations.
quotes.author: AnaÃ¯s Nin

quotes.quote: There is a collective as well as an individual humor inclining peoples to sadness or cheerfulness, making them see things in bright or somber lights. In fact, only society can pass a collective opinion on the value of human life; for this the individual is incompetent.
quotes.author: Emile Durkheim

quotes.quote: All parents damage their children. It cannot be helped. Youth, like pristine glass, absorbs the prints of its handlers. Some parents smudge, others crack, a few shatter childhoods completely into jagged little pieces, beyond repair.
quotes.author: Mitch Albom,  The Five People You Meet in Heaven

quotes.quote: Wisdom comes from experience. Experience is often a result of lack of wisdom.
quotes.author: Terry Pratchett

quotes.quote: A purpose of human life, no matter who is controlling it, is to love whoever is around to be loved.
quotes.author: Kurt Vonnegut,  The Sirens of Titan

quotes.quote: They say I'm old-fashioned, and live in the past, but sometimes I think progress progresses too fast!
quotes.author: Dr. Seuss

quotes.quote: Life is one big road with lots of signs. So when you riding through the ruts, don't complicate your mind. Flee from hate, mischief and jealousy. Don't bury your thoughts, put your vision to reality. Wake Up and Live!
quotes.author: Bob Marley

quotes.quote: Dwell on the beauty of life. Watch the stars, and see yourself running with them.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius,  Meditations

quotes.quote: Remember, remember, this is now, and now, and now. Live it, feel it, cling to it. I want to become acutely aware of all I've taken for granted.
quotes.author: Sylvia Plath

quotes.quote: There's nowhere you can be that isn't where you're meant to be...
quotes.author: John Lennon

quotes.quote: The trouble is if you don't spend your life yourself, other people spend it for you.
quotes.author: Peter Shaffer,  Five Finger Exercise: A Play

quotes.quote: God gave us the gift of life; it is up to us to give ourselves the gift of living well.
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.quote: Bad things do happen; how I respond to them defines my character and the quality of my life. I can choose to sit in perpetual sadness, immobilized by the gravity of my loss, or I can choose to rise from the pain and treasure the most precious gift I have - life itself.
quotes.author: Walter Anderson

quotes.quote: The reasonable man adapts himself to the world: the unreasonable one persists in trying to adapt the world to himself. Therefore all progress depends on the unreasonable man.
quotes.author: George Bernard Shaw,  Man and Superman

quotes.quote: Starting a business isn't for everyone, and it's not what you should do if you aren't sure what else to do. It requires thick skin and the willingness to carry a great deal of stress, sometimes alone. It's more often a life of failure than a life of success, and the majority of successes came after a long road of disappointment, and often shame.
quotes.author: Kathryn Minshew

quotes.quote: In a basic sense, 'A Little Life' is a homage to how my friends and I live our lives. I wanted to push past the definitions of how we typically define friendship. It's a different version of adulthood, but it's no less important and no less legitimate than anyone else's.
quotes.author: Hanya Yanagihara

quotes.quote: You have to have a sense of humor about life to get through it.
quotes.author: Kesha

quotes.quote: My mother was the most beautiful woman I ever saw. All I am I owe to my mother. I attribute all my success in life to the moral, intellectual and physical education I received from her.
quotes.author: George Washington

quotes.quote: The purpose of life is to live it, to taste experience to the utmost, to reach out eagerly and without fear for newer and richer experience.
quotes.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

quotes.quote: A sense of humor... is needed armor. Joy in one's heart and some laughter on one's lips is a sign that the person down deep has a pretty good grasp of life.
quotes.author: Hugh Sidey

quotes.quote: Difficult times always create opportunities for you to experience more love in your life.
quotes.author: Barbara de Angelis

quotes.quote: I don't get high, but sometimes I wish I did. That way, when I messed up in life I would have an excuse. But right now there's no rehab for stupidity.
quotes.author: Chris Rock

quotes.quote: please believe that things are good with me, and even when they're not, they will be soon enough. And i will always believe the same about you.
quotes.author: Stephen Chbosky,  The Perks of Being a Wallflower

quotes.quote: Not everything happens for a reason. Sometimes life just sucks.
quotes.author: Alexa Chung

quotes.quote: There can be nothing exclusive about substantial art. It comes directly out of the heart of the experience of life and thinking about life and living life.
quotes.author: Charles Ives

quotes.quote: Better to die fighting for freedom then be a prisoner all the days of your life.
quotes.author: Bob Marley

quotes.quote: You must not lose faith in humanity. Humanity is like an ocean; if a few drops of the ocean are dirty, the ocean does not become dirty.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: You will never change your life until you change something you do daily.
quotes.author: Mike Murdock

quotes.quote: Failure at some point in your life is inevitable, but giving up is unforgivable.
quotes.author: Joe Biden

quotes.quote: If I had my life to live over again, I would have made a rule to read some poetry and listen to some music at least once every week.
quotes.author: Charles Darwin,  The Autobiography of Charles Darwin, 1809-82

quotes.quote: I'm living by example by continuing on with my career and having a full, rich life, and I am incidentally gay.
quotes.author: Portia de Rossi

quotes.quote: The only way that we can live, is if we grow. The only way that we can grow is if we change. The only way that we can change is if we learn. The only way we can learn is if we are exposed. And the only way that we can become exposed is if we throw ourselves out into the open. Do it. Throw yourself.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: I only photograph myself at poignant moments in my life as a check of where I am and how large my thighs are.
quotes.author: Sam Taylor-Johnson

quotes.quote: The greatest happiness of life is the conviction that we are loved; loved for ourselves, or rather, loved in spite of ourselves.
quotes.author: Victor Hugo

quotes.quote: Poetry is often the art of overhearing yourself say things you didn't know you knew. It is a learned skill to force yourself to articulate your life, your present world or your possibilities for the future.
quotes.author: David Whyte

quotes.quote: I'm killing time while I wait for life to shower me with meaning and happiness.
quotes.author: Bill Watterson

quotes.quote: If you stay, I'll do whatever you want. I'll quit the band, go with you to New York. But if you need me to go away, I'll do that, too. I was talking to Liz and she said maybe coming back to your old life would be too painful, that maybe it'd be easier for you to erase us. And that would suck, but I'd do it. I can lose you like that if I don't lose you today. I'll let you go. If you stay.
quotes.author: Gayle Forman,  If I Stay

quotes.quote: There are two means of refuge from the misery of life -- music and cats.
quotes.author: Albert Schweitzer

quotes.quote: Never be bullied into silence. Never allow yourself to be made a victim. Accept no one's definition of your life, but define yourself.
quotes.author: Harvey Fierstein

quotes.quote: I'm very happy with my life. I am what I am. I don't worry about anything that I can't control. That's a really good lesson in life.
quotes.author: Tom Watson

quotes.quote: For those who have made the ultimate sacrifice, we are grateful that such men and women were among us. For those who continue to serve, we honor their commitment. For those who return to civilian life, we honor their service.
quotes.author: Steve Buyer

quotes.quote: Don't waste your time with explanations: people only hear what they want to hear.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho

quotes.quote: People with lots of doubts sometimes find life more oppressive and exhausting than others, but they're more energetic - they aren't robots.
quotes.author: Antonio Tabucchi

quotes.quote: Now and then it's good to pause in our pursuit of happiness and just be happy.

quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau,  Civil Disobedience and Other Essays

quotes.author: George Allen, Sr.

quotes.author: John Keats,  Letters of John Keats

quotes.author: Nancy Reagan

quotes.author: Louis Farrakhan

quotes.author: Mindy Kaling

quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  The Truth About Forever

quotes.quote: Children should be able to live a life free from bullying and harassment and it is time that we all took a stand against this.

quotes.author: Henry Miller,  Stand Still Like the Hummingbird

quotes.author: Mary Manin Morrissey

quotes.quote: God save us from people who mean well.

quotes.quote: People often claim to hunger for truth, but seldom like the taste when it's served up.

quotes.author: bell hooks

quotes.quote: The trouble with being in the rat race is that even if you win, you're still a rat.
quotes.author: Lily Tomlin

quotes.author: Pope Paul VI

quotes.quote: There is not a particle of life which does not bear poetry within it

quotes.author: Saint Patrick

quotes.quote: Caring - about people, about things, about life - is an act of maturity.
quotes.author: Tracy McMillan

quotes.quote: That's what literature is. It's the people who went before us, tapping out messages from the past, from beyond the grave, trying to tell us about life and death! Listen to them!

quotes.author: Jeffrey Kluger

quotes.quote: Listen to the people who love you. Believe that they are worth living for even when you don't believe it. Seek out the memories depression takes away and project them into the future. quotes.quote: To acquire the habit of reading is to construct for yourself a refuge from almost all the miseries of life.

quotes.quote: Almost nobody dances sober, unless they happen to be insane.

quotes.quote: The value of life lies not in the length of days, but in the use we make of them... Whether you find satisfaction in life depends not on your tale of years, but on your will.
quotes.author: Michel de Montaigne

quotes.author: Jason O'Mara

quotes.author: Khalil Gibran

quotes.quote: There are people in the world so hungry, that God cannot appear to them except in the form of bread.

quotes.quote: If you can do what you do best and be happy, you're further along in life than most people.

quotes.quote: A pain stabbed my heart, as it did every time I saw a girl I loved who was going the opposite direction in this too-big world.
quotes.author: Jack Kerouac,  On the Road

quotes.quote: Rain is grace; rain is the sky descending to the earth; without rain, there would be no life.
quotes.author: John Updike

quotes.quote: I believe that words are strong, that they can overwhelm what we fear when fear seems more awful than life is good.
quotes.author: Andrew Solomon,  The Noonday Demon: An Atlas of Depression

quotes.quote: The biggest adventure you can ever take is to live the life of your dreams.
quotes.author: Oprah Winfrey

quotes.quote: Each player must accept the cards life deals him or her: but once they are in hand, he or she alone must decide how to play the cards in order to win the game.

quotes.author: Teddy Thompson

quotes.quote: Don't be afraid of enemies who attack you. Be afraid of the friends who flatter you.
quotes.author: Dale Carnegie,  How to Win Friends and Influence People

quotes.quote: Why do they always teach us that it's easy and evil to do what we want and that we need discipline to restrain ourselves? It's the hardest thing in the world--to do what we want. And it takes the greatest kind of courage. I mean, what we really want.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: If you can find something you love, go for it everyday of your life, and it would be really good to you.
quotes.author: Jenifer Lewis

quotes.quote: I have been very blessed in my life and rewarded with good friends and good health. I am grateful and happy to be able to share this.
quotes.author: Eric Idle

quotes.quote: Without football, my life is worth nothing.
quotes.author: Cristiano Ronaldo

quotes.quote: If you want to make God laugh, tell him about your plans.
quotes.author: Woody Allen

quotes.quote: Life is pleasant. Death is peaceful. It's the transition that's troublesome.
quotes.author: Isaac Asimov

quotes.quote: There are two types of people in this world. People who hate clowns...and clowns. (Bobby Pendragon)
quotes.author: D.J. MacHale,  The Quillan Games

quotes.quote: Water and air, the two essential fluids on which all life depends, have become global garbage cans.
quotes.author: Jacques Yves Cousteau

quotes.quote: There is some kind of a sweet innocence in being human- in not having to be just happy or just sad- in the nature of being able to be both broken and whole, at the same time.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: Is it possible, in the final analysis, for one human being to achieve perfect understanding of another?We can invest enormous time and energy in serious efforts to know another person, but in the end, how close can we come to that person's essence? We convince ourselves that we know the other person well, but do we really know anything important about anyone?
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle

quotes.quote: And I hope that five years and 10 years from now, I'll be a better man, a more mature man, a wiser man, a more humble man and a more spirited man to serve the good of my people and the good of humanity.
quotes.author: Louis Farrakhan

quotes.quote: Having a baby is one of the most wonderful things in your life, as well as the hardest thing in your life.
quotes.author: Nuno Bettencourt

quotes.quote: Do I dare Disturb the universe? In a minute there is time For decisions and revisions which a minute will reverse.
quotes.author: T.S. Eliot

quotes.quote: Your children are not your children. They are the sons and daughters of Life's longing for itself. They came through you but not from you and though they are with you yet they belong not to you.
quotes.author: Khalil Gibran

quotes.quote: One ChoiceOne Choice, decided your friends.One Choice, defines your beliefs.One Choice, determines your loyalties - Forever.ONCE CHOICE CAN TRANSFORM YOU
quotes.author: Veronica Roth,  Divergent

quotes.quote: If there's a thing I've learned in my life it's to not be afraid of the responsibility that comes with caring for other people. What we do for love: those things endure. Even if the people you do them for don't
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare

quotes.quote: It is unwise to be too sure of one's own wisdom. It is healthy to be reminded that the strongest might weaken and the wisest might err.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: You've got to get obsessed and stay obsessed.
quotes.author: John Irving,  The Hotel New Hampshire

quotes.quote: I am awfully greedy; I want everything from life. I want to be a woman and to be a man, to have many friends and to have loneliness, to work much and write good books, to travel and enjoy myself, to be selfish and to be unselfish... You see, it is difficult to get all which I want. And then when I do not succeed I get mad with anger.
quotes.author: Simone de Beauvoir

quotes.quote: The only person who can pull me down is myself, and I'm not going to let myself pull me down anymore.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: Every man's life ends the same way. It is only the details of how he lived and how he died that distinguish one man from another.
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway

quotes.quote: Science is organized knowledge. Wisdom is organized life.
quotes.author: Immanuel Kant

quotes.quote: I think prime numbers are like life. They are very logical but you could never work out the rules, even if you spent all your time thinking about them
quotes.author: Mark Haddon,  The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time

quotes.quote: Pull up a chair. Take a taste. Come join us. Life is so endlessly delicious.
quotes.author: Ruth Reichl

quotes.quote: I live my life in widening circles that reach out across the world.
quotes.author: Rainer Maria Rilke,  Rilke's Book of Hours: Love Poems to God

quotes.quote: Marriage, for a woman at least, hampers the two things that made life to me glorious - friendship and learning.
quotes.author: Jane Harrison

quotes.quote: There's so much to appreciate about my life every single day, and I make a big point of taking time to smell the roses and noticing how lucky I am. I never want to take that for granted.
quotes.author: Josie Maran

quotes.quote: Sometimes the hardest part isn't letting go but rather learning to start over.
quotes.author: Nicole Sobon,  Program 13

quotes.quote: We're a depraved civilization. All this technology, all the computer games and the iPhones... nobody will sit for art anymore. What a dismaying state of humanity.
quotes.author: Diane Paulus

quotes.quote: Accept what life offers you and try to drink from every cup. All wines should be tasted; some should only be sipped, but with others, drink the whole bottle.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  Brida

quotes.quote: Art is built on the deepest themes of human meaning: good and evil, beauty and ugliness, life and death, love and hate. No other story has incarnated those themes more than the story of Jesus.
quotes.author: John Ortberg

quotes.quote: The most important thing is to enjoy your life - to be happy - it's all that matters.
quotes.author: Audrey Hepburn

quotes.quote: If only life could be a little more tender and art a little more robust.
quotes.author: Alan Rickman

quotes.quote: Lots of things can be fixed. Things can be fixed. But many times, relationships between people cannot be fixed, because they should not be fixed. You're aboard a ship setting sail, and the other person has joined the inland circus, or is boarding a different ship, and you just can't be with each other anymore. Because you shouldn't be.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: Do not dwell in the past, do not dream of the future, concentrate the mind on the present moment.
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.quote: [H]iding how you really feel and trying to make everyone happy doesn't make you nice, it just makes you a liar.
quotes.author: Jenny O'Connell,  The Book of Luke

quotes.quote: I believe in the city as a natural human environment, but we must humanize it. It's art that will re-define public space in the 21st Century. We can make our cities diverse, inspirational places by putting art, dance and performance in all its forms into the matrix of street life.
quotes.author: Antony Gormley

quotes.quote: Great art is the outward expression of an inner life in the artist, and this inner life will result in his personal vision of the world.
quotes.author: Edward Hopper

quotes.quote: That what I need to survive is not Gale's fire, kindled with rage and hatred. I have plenty of fire myself. What I need is the dandelion in the spring. The bright yellow that means rebirth instead of destruction. The promise that life can go on, no matter how bad our losses. That it can be good again. And only Peeta can give me that.
quotes.author: Suzanne Collins,  Mockingjay

quotes.quote: We do not remember days, we remember moments.
quotes.author: Cesare Pavese

quotes.quote: My view of life is colored by humor and looking at the best in any situation.
quotes.author: Michael J. Fox

quotes.quote: This must be Thursday,' said Arthur to himself, sinking low over his beer. 'I never could get the hang of Thursdays.
quotes.author: Douglas Adams,  The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

quotes.quote: Never complain, never explain. Resist the temptation to defend yourself or make excuses.
quotes.author: Brian Tracy

quotes.quote: Nothing ever happens like you imagine it will
quotes.author: John Green,  Paper Towns

quotes.quote: I love mankind, he said, "but I find to my amazement that the more I love mankind as a whole, the less I love man in particular.
quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky,  The Brothers Karamazov

quotes.quote: Growing up is losing some illusions, in order to acquire others.
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf

quotes.quote: In the end, it's not the years in your life that count. It's the life in your years.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: Simplicity is the keynote of all true elegance.
quotes.author: Coco Chanel

quotes.quote: Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: I think that we are like stars. Something happens to burst us open; but when we burst open and think we are dying; we're actually turning into a supernova. And then when we look at ourselves again, we see that we're suddenly more beautiful than we ever were before!
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: Life is a dream for the wise, a game for the fool, a comedy for the rich, a tragedy for the poor.
quotes.author: Sholom Aleichem

quotes.quote: I can tell if two people are in love by how they hold each other's hands, and how thick their sanitation gloves are.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: I am fated to journey hand in hand with my strange heroes and to survey the surging immensity of life, to survey it through the laughter that all can see and through the tears unseen and unknown by anyone.
quotes.author: Nikolai Gogol

quotes.quote: Life is not a problem to be solved, but a reality to be experienced.
quotes.author: Soren Kierkegaard

quotes.quote: I personally have dealt with any adversity in my life with humor. That's why I told America to 'Read my hips!' on 'Dancing With the Stars' or was happy to play along with Jason Alexander and Jerry Seinfeld in the great restaurant scene on 'Seinfeld.'
quotes.author: Marlee Matlin

quotes.quote: We could do it, you know.""What?""Leave the district. Run off. Live in the woods. You and I, we could make it.
quotes.author: Suzanne Collins,  The Hunger Games

quotes.quote: It's not the men in your life that matters, it's the life in your men.
quotes.author: Mae West

quotes.quote: Once I knew only darkness and stillness... my life was without past or future... but a little word from the fingers of another fell into my hand that clutched at emptiness, and my heart leaped to the rapture of living.
quotes.author: Helen Keller

quotes.quote: The truth is you don't know what is going to happen tomorrow. Life is a crazy ride, and nothing is guaranteed.
quotes.author: Eminem

quotes.quote: What good is the warmth of summer, without the cold of winter to give it sweetness.
quotes.author: John Steinbeck,  Travels with Charley: In Search of America

quotes.quote: If you live long enough, you'll make mistakes. But if you learn from them, you'll be a better person. It's how you handle adversity, not how it affects you. The main thing is never quit, never quit, never quit.
quotes.author: William J. Clinton

quotes.quote: Art imitates life and, sometimes, life imitates art. It's a weird combination of elements.
quotes.author: Bruce Willis

quotes.quote: Despite your best efforts, people are going to be hurt when it's time for them to be hurt.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  Norwegian Wood

quotes.quote: You know what I like most about people? Pets.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Who Moved My Choose?: An Amazing Way to Deal With Change by Deciding to Let Indecision Into Your Life

quotes.quote: Life is worth living as long as there's a laugh in it.
quotes.author: L.M. Montgomery,  Anne of Green Gables

quotes.quote: Life's most persistent and urgent question is, 'What are you doing for others?'
quotes.author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quotes.quote: Every luxury must be paid for, and everything is a luxury, starting with being in this world.
quotes.author: Cesare Pavese,  Il mestiere di vivere: Diario 1935-1950

quotes.quote: There are two tragedies in life. One is to lose your heart's desire. The other is to gain it.
quotes.author: George Bernard Shaw,  Man and Superman

quotes.quote: The best things in life make you sweaty.
quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe

quotes.quote: Scar tissue is stronger than regular tissue. Realize the strength, move on.
quotes.author: Henry Rollins

quotes.quote: When I consider life, it is all a cheat. Yet fooled with hope, people favor this deceit.
quotes.author: John Dryden

quotes.quote: Throughout life people will make you mad, disrespect you and treat you bad. Let God deal with the things they do, cause hate in your heart will consume you too.
quotes.author: Will Smith

quotes.quote: Life itself is offensive and certainly does not apologize - in fact, it hurts considerably and, as we all know, is often very rude and troublesome, just as nature or art can be.
quotes.author: Michael Leunig

quotes.quote: The purpose of our lives is to be happy.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama

quotes.quote: Oh, Life, I am yours. Whatever it is you want of me, I am ready to give.
quotes.author: William Steig,  Dominic

quotes.quote: My life is my message.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: People are like stained-glass windows. They sparkle and shine when the sun is out, but when the darkness sets in, their true beauty is revealed only if there is a light from within.
quotes.author: Elisabeth KÃ¼bler-Ross

quotes.quote: Parents were the only ones obligated to love you; from the rest of the world you had to earn it.
quotes.author: Ann Brashares,  Forever in Blue: The Fourth Summer of the Sisterhood

quotes.quote: Everything has been figured out, except how to live.
quotes.author: Jean-Paul Sartre

quotes.quote: Develop an interest in life as you see it; the people, things, literature, music - the world is so rich, simply throbbing with rich treasures, beautiful souls and interesting people. Forget yourself.
quotes.author: Henry Miller

quotes.quote: People have to forgive. We don't have to like them, we don't have to be friends with them, we don't have to send them hearts in text messages, but we have to forgive them, to overlook, to forget. Because if we don't we are tying rocks to our feet, too much for our wings to carry!
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: I'm sorry for my inability to let unimportant things go, for my inability to hold on to the important things.
quotes.author: Jonathan Safran Foer

quotes.quote: When in a relationship, a real man doesn't make his woman jealous of others, he makes others jealous of his woman.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: I don't live in either my past or my future. I'm interested only in the present. If you can concentrate always on the present, you'll be a happy man. Life will be a party for you, a grand festival, because life is the moment we're living now.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  The Alchemist

quotes.quote: To fear love is to fear life, and those who fear life are already 3-parts dead.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: The true secret of happiness lies in taking a genuine interest in all the details of daily life.
quotes.author: William Morris

quotes.quote: Every one of us is losing something precious to us. Lost opportunities, lost possibilities, feelings we can never get back again. That's part of what it means to be alive.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  Kafka on the Shore

quotes.quote: Life is too short, or too long, for me to allow myself the luxury of living it so badly.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho

quotes.quote: It's better to burn out than to fade away.
quotes.author: Neil Young

quotes.quote: Love and compassion are necessities, not luxuries. Without them, humanity cannot survive.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama XIV,  The Art of Happiness

quotes.quote: Rwanda can be a paradise again, but it will take the love of the entire world to heal my homeland. And that's as it should be, for what happened in Rwanda happened to us all - humanity was wounded by the genocide.
quotes.author: Immaculee Ilibagiza

quotes.quote: The aim of life is to live, and to live means to be aware, joyously, drunkenly, serenely, divinely aware.
quotes.author: Henry Miller

quotes.quote: How much I missed, simply because I was afraid of missing it.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  Brida

quotes.quote: Life isn't a matter of milestones, but of moments.
quotes.author: Rose Kennedy

quotes.quote: One always has a better book in one's mind than one can manage to get onto paper.
quotes.author: Michael Cunningham

quotes.quote: Who says life is fair, where is that written?
quotes.author: William Goldman,  The Princess Bride

quotes.quote: The privilege of a lifetime is being who you are.
quotes.author: Joseph Campbell

quotes.quote: Life is so beautiful that death has fallen in love with it, a jealous, possessive love that grabs at what it can. But life leaps over oblivion lightly, losing only a thing or two of no importance, and gloom is but the passing shadow of a cloud...
quotes.author: Yann Martel,  Life of Pi

quotes.quote: It all goes away. Eventually, everything goes away.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Eat, Pray, Love

quotes.quote: Man is condemned to be free; because once thrown into the world, he is responsible for everything he does. It is up to you to give [life] a meaning.
quotes.author: Jean-Paul Sartre

quotes.quote: Why can't people just sit and read books and be nice to each other?
quotes.author: David Baldacci,  The Camel Club

quotes.quote: My body is my journal, and my tattoos are my story.
quotes.author: Johnny Depp

quotes.quote: One way to get the most out of life is to look upon it as an adventure.
quotes.author: William Feather

quotes.quote: I know that the whole point--the only point--is tofind the things that matter, and hold on to them, and fight for them, and refuse tolet them go.
quotes.author: Lauren Oliver,  Delirium

quotes.quote: Writers fish for the right words like fishermen fish for, um, whatever those aquatic creatures with fins and gills are called.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This is the best book I've ever written, and it still sucks

quotes.quote: There is nothing more rare, nor more beautiful, than a woman being unapologetically herself; comfortable in her perfect imperfection. To me, that is the true essence of beauty.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Everyone is flailing through this life without an owner's manual, with whatever modicum of grace and good humor we can manage.
quotes.author: Anne Lamott

quotes.quote: Learning to let go should be learned before learning to get. Life should be touched, not strangled. You've got to relax, let it happen at times, and at others move forward with it.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury

quotes.quote: Those who are willing to be vulnerable move among mysteries.
quotes.author: Theodore Roethke,  Straw for the Fire: From the Notebooks of Theodore Roethke

quotes.quote: One of the few good things about modern times: If you die horribly on television, you will not have died in vain. You will have entertained us.
quotes.author: Kurt Vonnegut

quotes.quote: Our true friends are those who are with us when the good things happen. They cheer us on and are pleased by our triumphs. False friends only appear at difficult times, with their sad, supportive faces, when, in fact, our suffering is serving to console them for their miserable lives.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  The Zahir

quotes.quote: This life, which had been the tomb of his virtue and of his honour, is but a walking shadow; a poor player, that struts and frets his hour upon the stage, and then is heard no more: it is a tale told by an idiot, full of sound and fury, signifying nothing.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.quote: You spend your whole life stuck in the labyrinth, thinking about how you'll escape one day, and how awesome it will be, and imagining that future keeps you going, but you never do it. You just use the future to escape the present.
quotes.author: John Green,  Looking for Alaska

quotes.quote: A quiet secluded life in the country, with the possibility of being useful to people to whom it is easy to do good, and who are not accustomed to have it done to them; then work which one hopes may be of some use; then rest, nature, books, music, love for one's neighbor -- such is my idea of happiness.
quotes.author: Leo Tolstoy,  Family Happiness

quotes.quote: Life's as kind as you let it be.
quotes.author: Charles Bukowski,  Hot Water Music

quotes.quote: Life is a series of natural and spontaneous changes. Don't resist them - that only creates sorrow. Let reality be reality. Let things flow naturally forward in whatever way they like.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.quote: Many people die at twenty five and aren't buried until they are seventy five.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.quote: A man with outward courage dares to die; a man with inner courage dares to live.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu,  Tao Te Ching

quotes.quote: The key to success is to keep growing in all areas of life - mental, emotional, spiritual, as well as physical.
quotes.author: Julius Erving

quotes.quote: All life demands struggle. Those who have everything given to them become lazy, selfish, and insensitive to the real values of life. The very striving and hard work that we so constantly try to avoid is the major building block in the person we are today.
quotes.author: Pope Paul VI

quotes.quote: I believe there is another world waiting for us. A better world. And I'll be waiting for you there.
quotes.author: David Mitchell,  Cloud Atlas

quotes.quote: We live and breathe words.

quotes.quote: Paradoxically though it may seem, it is none the less true that life imitates art far more than art imitates life.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Let there be freedom for the Indians, wherever they may be in the American Continent or elsewhere in the world, because while they are alive, a glow of hope will be alive as well as a true concept of life.
quotes.author: Rigoberta Menchu

quotes.quote: Just as a candle cannot burn without fire, men cannot live without a spiritual life.
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.quote: It is art that makes life, makes interest, makes importance... and I know of no substitute whatever for the force and beauty of its process.
quotes.author: Henry James

quotes.quote: When a girl says she wants to be friends with benefits, I always ask if that includes dental insurance.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  It Occurred to Me

quotes.quote: In everybody's life there's a point of no return. And in a very few cases, a point where you can't go forward anymore. And when we reach that point, all we can do is quietly accept the fact. That's how we survive.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  Kafka on the Shore

quotes.quote: When a woman becomes her own best friend life is easier.
quotes.author: Diane Von Furstenberg

quotes.quote: What would come, would come...and you would have to meet it, when it did.
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

quotes.quote: From too much love of living, From hope and fear set free, We thank with brief thanksgiving Whatever gods may be That no life lives for ever; That dead men rise up never; That even the weariest river Winds somewhere safe to sea.
quotes.author: Algernon Charles Swinburne

quotes.quote: This life is like a swimming pool. You dive into the water, but you can't see how deep it is.
quotes.author: Dennis Rodman

quotes.quote: How can I be reasonable? To me our love was everything and you were my whole life. It is not very pleasant to realize that to you it was only an episode.
quotes.author: W. Somerset Maugham,  The Painted Veil

quotes.quote: I try to give people hope. Even though life is bleak, there's hope out there.
quotes.author: Danielle Steel

quotes.quote: Loneliness adds beauty to life. It puts a special burn on sunsets and makes night air smell better.
quotes.author: Henry Rollins

quotes.quote: He's not your prince charming if he doesn't make sure you know that you're his princess.
quotes.author: Demi Lovato

quotes.quote: My one regret in life is that I am not someone else.
quotes.author: Woody Allen

quotes.quote: As soon as you trust yourself, you will know how to live.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe,  Faust: First Part

quotes.quote: I'm most proud of the blessings that God has bestowed upon me, in my life. He's given me the vision to truly see that you can fall down, but you can still get back up. Hopefully I'll learn from my mistakes and have the opportunity to strengthen and improve the next thing I do.
quotes.author: Martin Lawrence

quotes.quote: The world is a tragedy to those who feel, but a comedy to those who think.
quotes.author: Horace Walpole

quotes.quote: I wonder why I don't go to bed and go to sleep. But then it would be tomorrow, so I decide that no matter how tired, no matter how incoherent I am, I can skip on hour more of sleep and live.
quotes.author: Sylvia Plath,  The Unabridged Journals of Sylvia Plath

quotes.quote: Some of us get dipped in flat, some in satin, some in gloss...."He turned to me. "But every once in a while, you find someone who's iridescent, and when you do, nothing will ever compare.
quotes.author: Wendelin Van Draanen,  Flipped

quotes.quote: False friendship, like the ivy, decays and ruins the walls it embraces; but true friendship gives new life and animation to the object it supports.
quotes.author: Richard Burton

quotes.quote: I can see how it might be possible for a man to look down upon the earth and be an atheist, but I cannot conceive how a man could look up into the heavens and say there is no God.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: She burned too bright for this world.
quotes.author: Emily BrontÃ«,  Wuthering Heights

quotes.quote: But how could you live and have no story to tell?
quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky,  White Nights

quotes.quote: Winning is great, sure, but if you are really going to do something in life, the secret is learning how to lose. Nobody goes undefeated all the time. If you can pick up after a crushing defeat, and go on to win again, you are going to be a champion someday.
quotes.author: Wilma Rudolph

quotes.quote: The two most important days in your life are the day you are born and the day you find out why.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: You're on Earth. There's no cure for that.
quotes.author: Samuel Beckett

quotes.quote: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you've imagined.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.quote: I told her I'd wait forever for her, but that was before I found somebody else who'd give me a ride home.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: We all make mistakes, have struggles, and even regret things in our past. But you are not your mistakes, you are not your struggles, and you are here NOW with the power to shape your day and your future.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: When you can live forever what do you live for?
quotes.author: Stephenie Meyer

quotes.quote: Oh the places you'll go! There is fun to be done! There are points to be scored. There are games to be won. And the magical things you can do with that ball will make you the winning-est winner of all.
quotes.author: Dr. Seuss,  Oh, The Places You'll Go!

quotes.quote: Alone we can do so little; together we can do so much
quotes.author: Helen Keller
