quotes.quote: He was mastered by the sheer surging of life, the tidal wave of being, the perfect joy of each separate muscle, joint, and sinew in that it was everything that was not death, that it was aglow and rampant, expressing itself in movement, flying exultantly under the stars.
quotes.author: Jack London,  The Call of the Wild

quotes.quote: We are at our very best, and we are happiest, when we are fully engaged in work we enjoy on the journey toward the goal we've established for ourselves. It gives meaning to our time off and comfort to our sleep. It makes everything else in life so wonderful, so worthwhile.
quotes.author: Earl Nightingale

quotes.quote: Don't leave a piece of jewelry at his house so you can go back and get it later; he may be with his real girlfriend.
quotes.author: Amy Sedaris,  I Like You: Hospitality Under the Influence

quotes.quote: You can never really know someone completely. That's why it's the most terrifying thing in the world, really--taking someone on faith, hoping they'll take you on faith too. It's such a precarious balance, It's a wonder we do it at all. And yet..
quotes.author: Libba Bray

quotes.quote: Often, it's not about becoming a new person, but becoming the person you were meant to be, and already are, but don't know how to be.
quotes.author: Heath L. Buckmaster,  Box of Hair: A Fairy Tale

quotes.quote: I don't care if you're black, white, straight, bisexual, gay, lesbian, short, tall, fat, skinny, rich or poor. If you're nice to me, I'll be nice to you. Simple as that.
quotes.author: Robert Michaels MD - 2007 - Graduation Speaker

quotes.quote: Always keep your smile. That's how I explain my long life.
quotes.author: Jeanne Calment

quotes.quote: You must learn to let go. Release the stress. You were never in control anyway.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: I can't decide whether I'm a good girl wrapped up in a bad girl, or if I'm a bad girl wrapped up in a good girl. And that's how I know I'm a woman!
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: Then, one stupid person, no different from any other stupid person, wanders into your stupid life...you give them a piece of you. They don't ask for it. They do something dumb one day like kiss you or smile at you, and then your life isn't your own anymore.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman,  The Sandman, Vol. 9: The Kindly Ones

quotes.quote: The whole of life is just like watching a film. Only it's as though you always get in ten minutes after the big picture has started, and no-one will tell you the plot, so you have to work it out all yourself from the clues.
quotes.author: Terry Pratchett,  Moving Pictures

quotes.quote: At the end of the day, let there be no excuses, no explanations, no regrets.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: People tell you the world looks a certain way. Parents tell you how to think. Schools tell you how to think. TV. Religion. And then at a certain point, if you're lucky, you realize you can make up your own mind. Nobody sets the rules but you. You can design your own life.
quotes.author: Carrie-Anne Moss

quotes.quote: My favorite things in life don't cost any money. It's really clear that the most precious resource we all have is time.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.quote: I'm the most terrific liar you ever saw in your life. It's awful. If I'm on my way to the store to buy a magazine, even, and somebody asks me where I'm going, I'm liable to say I'm going to the opera. It's terrible.
quotes.author: J.D. Salinger,  The Catcher in the Rye

quotes.quote: You've a good heart. Sometimes that's enough to see you safe wherever you go. But mostly, it's not.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman,  Neverwhere

quotes.quote: A painter's tastes must grow out of what so obsesses him in life that he never has to ask himself what it is suitable for him to do in art.
quotes.author: Lucian Freud

quotes.quote: To perceive is to suffer.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The essence of being human is that one does not seek perfection.
quotes.author: George Orwell,  In Front of Your Nose: 1945-1950

quotes.quote: I know it seems hard sometimes but remember one thing. Through every dark night, there's a bright day after that. So no matter how hard it get, stick your chest out, keep ya head up.... and handle it.
quotes.author: Tupac Shakur

quotes.quote: Keep your best wishes, close to your heart and watch what happens
quotes.author: Tony DeLiso,  Legacy: The Power Within

quotes.quote: So it's true, when all is said and done, grief is the price we pay for love.
quotes.author: E.A. Bucchianeri,  Brushstrokes of a Gadfly

quotes.quote: Happiness is a choice. You can choose to be happy. There's going to be stress in life, but it's your choice whether you let it affect you or not.
quotes.author: Valerie Bertinelli

quotes.quote: Make a pact with yourself today to not be defined by your past. Sometimes the greatest thing to come out of all your hard work isn't what you get for it, but what you become for it. Shake things up today! Be You...Be Free...Share.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: The meaning of life is that it stops.
quotes.author: Franz Kafka

quotes.quote: Romance novels are birthday cake and life is often peanut butter and jelly. I think everyone should have lots of delicious romance novels lying around for those times when the peanut butter of life gets stuck to the roof of your mouth.
quotes.author: Janet Evanovich

quotes.quote: There's nothing more embarrassing than to have earned the disfavor of a perceptive animal.
quotes.author: Michael Chabon,  Wonder Boys

quotes.quote: I'm not in search of sanctity, sacredness, purity; these things are found after this life, not in this life; but in this life I search to be completely human: to feel, to give, to take, to laugh, to get lost, to be found, to dance, to love and to lust, to be so human.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: Life is never all one thing. It bounces around. Certainly, my own life has. Look at Woody Allen's funny movies - all the humor comes out of sad stuff. Sometimes you have to laugh, no matter what life deals you.
quotes.author: Tim O'Brien

quotes.quote: Live not for Battles Won.Live not for The-End-of-the-Song. Live in the along.
quotes.author: Gwendolyn Brooks,  Report from Part One

quotes.quote: Your life is an occasion. Rise to it.
quotes.author: Suzanne Weyn,  Mr. Magorium's Wonder Emporium

quotes.quote: nothing in this world was more difficult than love.
quotes.author: Gabriel GarcÃ­Â­a MÃ¡rquez

quotes.quote: We need to move into a culture of peace. What I hope to promote is the idea that we all need each other and that the greatest happiness in life is not how much we have but how much we give. That's a wealth that's priceless. You can't buy compassion.
quotes.author: Herbie Hancock

quotes.quote: Our heavenly Father understands our disappointment, suffering, pain, fear, and doubt. He is always there to encourage our hearts and help us understand that He's sufficient for all of our needs. When I accepted this as an absolute truth in my life, I found that my worrying stopped.
quotes.author: Charles Stanley

quotes.quote: Society is like a large piece of frozen water; and skating well is the great art of social life.
quotes.author: Letitia Elizabeth Landon

quotes.quote: The funniest people are the saddest ones
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.quote: Accept the things to which fate binds you, and love the people with whom fate brings you together,but do so with all your heart.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius,  Meditations

quotes.quote: Life isn't about waiting for the storm to pass...It's about learning to dance in the rain.
quotes.author: Vivian Greene

quotes.quote: I've been absolutely terrified every moment of my life - and I've never let it keep me from doing a single thing I wanted to do.
quotes.author: Georgia O'Keeffe

quotes.quote: Too often in life, something happens and we blame other people for us not being happy or satisfied or fulfilled. So the point is, we all have choices, and we make the choice to accept people or situations or to not accept situations.
quotes.author: Tom Brady

quotes.quote: Life was meant to be lived, and curiosity must be kept alive. One must never, for whatever reason, turn his back on life.
quotes.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

quotes.quote: You were given life; it is your duty (and also your entitlement as a human being) to find something beautiful within life, no matter how slight.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Gilbert

quotes.quote: I have often wished I had time to cultivate modesty...But I am too busy thinking about myself.
quotes.author: Edith Sitwell

quotes.quote: Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.quote: Sleep my little baby-ohSleep until you wakenWhen you wake you'll see the worldIf I'm not mistaken...Kiss a loverDance a measure,Find your nameAnd buried treasure...Face your lifeIts pain, Its pleasure,Leave no path untaken.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman,  The Graveyard Book

quotes.quote: The greatest thing about where my life is right now is it's very relaxed and chill. I'm just hanging out, being myself and doing my work.
quotes.author: Lucas Grabeel

quotes.quote: I don't care what you say to me. I care what you share with me.
quotes.author: Santosh Kalwar,  Quote Me Everyday

quotes.quote: Our lives are not as limited as we think they are; the world is a wonderfully weird place; consensual reality is significantly flawed; no institution can be trusted, but love does work; all things are possible; and we all could be happy and fulfilled if we only had the guts to be truly free and the wisdom to shrink our egos and quit taking ourselves so damn seriously.
quotes.author: Tom Robbins

quotes.quote: My father had taught me to be nice first, because you can always be mean later, but once you've been mean to someone, they won't believe the nice anymore. So be nice, be nice, until it's time to stop being nice, then destroy them.
quotes.author: Laurell K. Hamilton,  A Stroke of Midnight

quotes.quote: Life is a series of experiences, each one of which makes us bigger, even though sometimes it is hard to realize this. For the world was built to develop character, and we must learn that the setbacks and grieves which we endure help us in our marching onward.
quotes.author: Henry Ford

quotes.quote: I envy people that know love. That have someone who takes them as they are.
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  The Devilin Fey

quotes.quote: All the adversity I've had in my life, all my troubles and obstacles, have strengthened me... You may not realize it when it happens, but a kick in the teeth may be the best thing in the world for you.
quotes.author: Walt Disney

quotes.quote: I have no faith in human perfectibility. I think that human exertion will have no appreciable effect upon humanity. Man is now only more active - not more happy - nor more wise, than he was 6000 years ago.
quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe

quotes.quote: Don't be too timid and squeamish about your actions. All life is an experiment. The more experiments you make the better.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson,  Journals of Ralph Waldo Emerson, with Annotations - 1841-1844

quotes.quote: The only way to survive eternity is to be able to appreciate each moment.
quotes.author: Lauren Kate,  Fallen

quotes.quote: We are all the pieces of what we remember. We hold in ourselves the hopes and fears of those who love us. As long as there is love and memory, there is no true loss.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Heavenly Fire

quotes.quote: Sadness gives depth. Happiness gives height. Sadness gives roots. Happiness gives branches. Happiness is like a tree going into the sky, and sadness is like the roots going down into the womb of the earth. Both are needed, and the higher a tree goes, the deeper it goes, simultaneously. The bigger the tree, the bigger will be its roots. In fact, it is always in proportion. That's its balance.
quotes.author: Osho,  Everyday Osho: 365 Daily Meditations for the Here and Now

quotes.quote: I'm quite detached from failure and success. Once a shooting is done, I kind of close that chapter in my life.
quotes.author: Ranbir Kapoor

quotes.quote: Do not wait for the last judgment. It comes every day.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: It is important that we forgive ourselves for making mistakes. We need to learn from our errors and move on.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: My life didn't please me, so I created my life.
quotes.author: Coco Chanel

quotes.quote: I am my own biggest critic. Before anyone else has criticized me, I have already criticized myself. But for the rest of my life, I am going to be with me and I don't want to spend my life with someone who is always critical. So I am going to stop being my own critic. It's high time that I accept all the great things about me.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: When the going gets weird, the weird turn professional.
quotes.author: Hunter S. Thompson,  Fear and Loathing on the Campaign Trail '72

quotes.quote: Achieve success in any area of life by identifying the optimum strategies and repeating them until they become habits.
quotes.author: Charles J. Givens

quotes.quote: The boundaries which divide Life from Death are at best shadowy and vague. Who shall say where the one ends, and where the other begins?
quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe

quotes.quote: But when it came right down to it, the skin of my wrist looked so white and defensless that I couldn't do it. It was as if what I wanted to kill wasn't in that skin or the thin blue pulse that jumped under my thumb, but somewhere else, deeper, more secret, and a whole lot harder to get.
quotes.author: Sylvia Plath,  The Bell Jar

quotes.quote: When we remember we are all mad, the mysteries disappear and life stands explained.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: Sacrifice is a part of life. It's supposed to be. It's not something to regret. It's something to aspire to.
quotes.author: Mitch Albom,  The Five People You Meet in Heaven

quotes.quote: Bottom line is, even if you see 'em coming, you're not ready for the big moments. No one asks for their life to change, not really. But it does. So what are we, helpless? Puppets? No. The big moments are gonna come. You can't help that. It's what you do afterwards that counts. That's when you find out who you are.
quotes.author: Joss Whedon

quotes.quote: Macro-trading requires a high degree of skill, focus and repetition. Life events, such as birth, divorce, death of a loved one and other emotional highs and lows are obstacles to success in this specific field of finance.
quotes.author: Paul Tudor Jones

quotes.quote: Life is a series of pulls back and forth... A tension of opposites, like a pull on a rubber band. Most of us live somewhere in the middle. A wrestling match...Which side win? Love wins. Love always wins
quotes.author: Mitch Albom,  Tuesdays with Morrie

quotes.quote: The best of us must sometimes eat our words.
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling

quotes.quote: I will not try to convince you to love me, to respect me, to commit to me. I deserve better than that; I AM BETTER THAN THAT...Goodbye.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Success is not how many zeroes your bank account has. It's about making the most of the life you have.
quotes.author: Suze Orman

quotes.quote: The life of the dead is placed in the memory of the living.
quotes.author: Marcus Tullius Cicero

quotes.quote: I don't want to achieve immortality through my work; I want to achieve immortality through not dying. I don't want to live on in the hearts of my countrymen; I want to live on in my apartment.
quotes.author: Woody Allen,  Illustrated Woody Allen Reader

quotes.quote: Unlike a drop of water which loses its identity when it joins the ocean, man does not lose his being in the society in which he lives. Man's life is independent. He is born not for the development of the society alone, but for the development of his self.
quotes.author: B. R. Ambedkar

quotes.quote: No man ever steps in the same river twice, for it's not the same river and he's not the same man.
quotes.author: Heraclitus

quotes.quote: We're here, and then we're gone, and it's not about the time we're here, but what we do with the time.
quotes.author: Rick Yancey,  The 5th Wave

quotes.quote: Human life is but a series of footnotes to a vast obscure unfinished masterpiece
quotes.author: Vladimir Nabokov,  Lolita

quotes.quote: When you arise in the morning think of what a privilege it is to be alive, to think, to enjoy, to love ...
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius,  Meditations

quotes.quote: Friends are the family you choose (~ Nin/Ithilnin, Elven rogue).
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  The Other Side of Life

quotes.quote: Happiness is not a goal...it's a by-product of a life well lived.
quotes.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

quotes.quote: You cannot change what you are, only what you do.
quotes.author: Philip Pullman,  The Golden Compass

quotes.quote: I am the Way, the Truth, and the Life. No one comes to the Father except through me.
quotes.author: Jesus Christ

quotes.quote: Growing up happens when you start having things you look back on and wish you could change -Clary Fray
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Ashes

quotes.quote: Magic exists. Who can doubt it, when there are rainbows and wildflowers, the music of the wind and the silence of the stars? Anyone who has loved has been touched by magic. It is such a simple and such an extraordinary part of the lives we live.
quotes.author: Nora Roberts

quotes.quote: The meaning I picked, the one that changed my life: Overcome fear, behold wonder.
quotes.author: Richard Bach

quotes.quote: Nothing good comes in life or athletics unless a lot of hard work has preceded the effort. Only temporary success is achieved by taking short cuts.
quotes.author: Roger Staubach

quotes.quote: You don't have to have anything in common with people you've known since you were five. With old friends, you've got your whole life in common.
quotes.author: Lyle Lovett

quotes.quote: If you're horrible to me, I'm going to write a song about it, and you won't like it. That's how I operate.
quotes.author: Taylor Swift

quotes.quote: Renew, release, let go. Yesterday's gone. There's nothing you can do to bring it back. You can't 'should've' done something. You can only DO something. Renew yourself. Release that attachment. Today is a new day!
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: You do not immortalize the lost by writing about them. Language buries, but does not resurrect.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: You never know what's around the corner. It could be everything. Or it could be nothing. You keep putting one foot in front of the other, and then one day you look back and you've climbed a mountain.
quotes.author: Tom Hiddleston

quotes.quote: Successful people are always looking for opportunities to help others. Unsuccessful people are always asking, "What's in it for me?
quotes.author: Brian Tracy

quotes.quote: Life will not break your heart. It'll crush it.
quotes.author: Henry Rollins

quotes.quote: Life is one grand, sweet song, so start the music.
quotes.author: Ronald Reagan

quotes.quote: There are people who are generic. They make generic responses and they expect generic answers. They live inside a box and they think people who don't fit into their box are weird. But I'll tell you what, generic people are the weird people. They are like genetically-manipulated plants growing inside a laboratory, like indistinguishable faces, like droids. Like ignorance.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: When two people are under the influence of the most violent, most insane, most delusive, and most transient of passions, they are required to swear that they will remain in that excited, abnormal, and exhausting condition continuously until death do them part.
quotes.author: George Bernard Shaw,  Getting Married

quotes.quote: I feel that life is divided into the horrible and the miserable. That's the two categories. The horrible are like, I don't know, terminal cases, you know, and blind people, crippled. I don't know how they get through life. It's amazing to me. And the miserable is everyone else. So you should be thankful that you're miserable, because that's very lucky, to be miserable.
quotes.author: Woody Allen,  Annie Hall: Screenplay

quotes.quote: Time takes it all, whether you want it to or not.
quotes.author: Stephen King,  The Green Mile

quotes.quote: Our lives are defined by opportunities, even the ones we miss.
quotes.author: Eric Roth,  The Curious Case of Benjamin Button Screenplay

quotes.quote: No! Try not. Do, or do not. There is no try.
quotes.author: George Lucas,  The Star Wars Trilogy

quotes.quote: How would your life be different if...You walked away from gossip and verbal defamation? Let today be the day...You speak only the good you know of other people and encourage others to do the same.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: I'm the one that has to die when it's time for me to die, so let me live my life, the way I want to.
quotes.author: Jimi Hendrix

quotes.quote: To be creative means to be in love with life. You can be creative only if you love life enough that you want to enhance its beauty, you want to bring a little more music to it, a little more poetry to it, a little more dance to it.
quotes.author: Osho

quotes.quote: Don't sacrifice yourself too much, because if you sacrifice too much there's nothing else you can give and nobody will care for you.
quotes.author: Karl Lagerfeld

quotes.quote: Very occasionally, if you pay really close attention, life doesn't suck.
quotes.author: Joss Whedon

quotes.quote: Tears, idle tears, I know not what they mean, Tears from the depths of some devine despairRise in the heart, and gather to the eyes, In looking on the happy autumn fields, And thinking of the days that are no more.
quotes.author: Alfred Lord Tennyson

quotes.quote: She is free in her wildness, she is a wanderess, a drop of free water. She knows nothing of borders and cares nothing for rules or customs. 'Time' for her isn't something to fight against. Her life flows clean, with passion, like fresh water.
quotes.author: Roman Payne

quotes.quote: Action expresses priorities.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: Don't think about making life better for other people who don't even deserve you, rather, focus on making your life the best, for yourself and those who love you.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: You never knew the last time you were seeing someone. You didn't know when the last argument happened, or the last time you had sex, or the last time you looked into their eyes and thanked God they were in your life.After they were gone?That was all you thought about.Day and night.
quotes.author: J.R. Ward,  Lover Mine

quotes.quote: A 'naughty pickle' is how I'd best describe myself. I think fun and laughter is the whole point of life.
quotes.author: Celia Imrie

quotes.quote: You don't have to disrespect and insult others simply to hold your own ground. If you do, that shows how shaky your own position is.
quotes.author: Red Haircrow

quotes.quote: Perhaps naively I thought people understand what humor was, that it was invented by the human race to cope with the dark areas of life, problems and terrors.
quotes.author: Bill Forsyth

quotes.quote: Life imitates art far more than art imitates Life.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: The future is something which everyone reaches at the rate of sixty minutes an hour, whatever he does, whoever he is.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: Just living is not enough,"said the butterfly, "one must have sunshine, freedom, and a little flower.
quotes.author: Hans Christian Andersen,  The Complete Fairy Tales

quotes.quote: The greatest sweetener of human life is Friendship. To raise this to the highest pitch of enjoyment, is a secret which but few discover.
quotes.author: Joseph Addison

quotes.quote: People grow through experience if they meet life honestly and courageously. This is how character is built.
quotes.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

quotes.quote: In all of living, have much fun and laughter. Life is to be enjoyed, not just endured.
quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley

quotes.quote: Remember that everyone you meet is afraid of something, loves something and has lost something.
quotes.author: H. Jackson Brown Jr.

quotes.quote: It is wise to direct your anger towards problems -- not people; to focus your energies on answers -- not excuses.
quotes.author: William Arthur Ward

quotes.quote: The person you became with her is worth being.
quotes.author: Veronica Roth,  Allegiant

quotes.quote: Your conscience is the measure of the honesty of your selfishness.Listen to it carefully.
quotes.author: Richard Bach,  Illusions: The Adventures of a Reluctant Messiah

quotes.quote: Far and away the best prize that life has to offer is the chance to work hard at work worth doing.
quotes.author: Theodore Roosevelt

quotes.quote: If there were such a thing as terminal literalism, you'd have died in childhood.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Bones

quotes.quote: A man's true character comes out when he's drunk.
quotes.author: Charlie Chaplin

quotes.quote: Don't ask for guarantees. And don't look to be saved in any one thing, person, machine, or library. Do your own bit of saving, and if you drown, at least die knowing you were heading for shore.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury,  Fahrenheit 451

quotes.quote: If you want to do really important things in life and big things in life, you can't do anything by yourself. And your best teams are your friends and your siblings.
quotes.author: Deepak Chopra

quotes.quote: I just wanted to tell you that I understand if you go. It's okay if you have to leave us. It's okay if you want to stop fighting.
quotes.author: Gayle Forman,  If I Stay

quotes.quote: If it's true that our species is alone in the universe, then I'd have to say the universe aimed rather low and settled for very little.
quotes.author: George Carlin,  Napalm & Silly Putty

quotes.quote: Holding on to anger, resentment and hurt only gives you tense muscles, a headache and a sore jaw from clenching your teeth. Forgiveness gives you back the laughter and the lightness in your life.
quotes.author: Joan Lunden

quotes.quote: Prime numbers are what is left when you have taken all the patterns away. I think prime numbers are like life. They are very logical but you could never work out the rules, even if you spent all your time thinking about them.
quotes.author: Mark Haddon,  The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time

quotes.quote: There are no random acts...We are all connected...You can no more separate one life from another than you can separate a breeze from the wind...
quotes.author: Mitch Albom,  The Five People You Meet in Heaven

quotes.quote: The essential lesson I've learned in life is to just be yourself. Treasure the magnificent being that you are and recognize first and foremost you're not here as a human being only. You're a spiritual being having a human experience.
quotes.author: Wayne Dyer

quotes.quote: Art is nothing but the expression of our dream; the more we surrender to it the closer we get to the inner truth of things, our dream-life, the true life that scorns questions and does not see them.
quotes.author: Franz Marc

quotes.quote: The story of life is quicker than the wink of an eye, the story of love is hello and goodbye...until we meet again
quotes.author: Jimi Hendrix

quotes.quote: I don't understand people who say they need more "Me Time."What other time is there? Do these people spend part of their day in someone else's body?
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Man is a mystery. It needs to be unravelled, and if you spend your whole life unravelling it, don't say that you've wasted time. I am studying that mystery because I want to be a human being.
quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky

quotes.quote: People come together with their families to celebrate Easter. What better way to celebrate than to spend a few hours going on the journey of Christ's life.
quotes.author: Roma Downey

quotes.quote: Life is funny. Things change, people change, but you will always be you, so stay true to yourself and never sacrifice who you are for anyone.
quotes.author: Zayn Malik

quotes.quote: I don't think that there are any limits to how excellent we could make life seem.
quotes.author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Everything Is Illuminated

quotes.quote: The whole notion of pain, and how every individual experiences pain, is up for debate. We don't know how another person experiences pain - physical pain or psychic pain. Some of these clinics where assisted suicide or euthanasia is practiced, they call it 'weariness of life.'
quotes.author: Miriam Toews

quotes.quote: Inventory:"Four be the things I am wiser to know:Idleness, sorrow, a friend, and a foe.Four be the things I'd been better without:Love, curiosity, freckles, and doubt.Three be the things I shall never attain:Envy, content, and sufficient champagne.Three be the things I shall have till I die:Laughter and hope and a sock in the eye.
quotes.author: Dorothy Parker,  The Complete Poems of Dorothy Parker

quotes.quote: Though the road's been rocky it sure feels good to me.
quotes.author: Bob Marley

quotes.quote: The primary source of the appeal of Christianity was Jesus - His incarnation, His life, His crucifixion, and His resurrection.
quotes.author: Kenneth Scott Latourette

quotes.quote: If you hang out with chickens, you're going to cluck and if you hang out with eagles, you're going to fly.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Let me encourage you to get up every day and focus on what you do have in life. Be thankful for the blessings of the little things, even when you don't get what you expect.
quotes.author: Victoria Osteen

quotes.quote: Forget yesterday - it has already forgotten you. Don't sweat tomorrow - you haven't even met. Instead, open your eyes and your heart to a truly precious gift - today.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Life is like a novel. It's filled with suspense. You have no idea what is going to happen until you turn the page.
quotes.author: Sidney Sheldon

quotes.quote: I want my kids to have the things in life that I never had when I was growing up. Things like beards and chest hair.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  I Want

quotes.quote: You must not ever stop being whimsical. And you must not, ever, give anyone else the responsibility for your life.
quotes.author: Mary Oliver,  Wild Geese

quotes.quote: Life is a journey. Time is a river. The door is ajar
quotes.author: Jim Butcher,  Dead Beat

quotes.quote: Just keep moving forward and don't give a shit about what anybody thinks. Do what you have to do, for you.
quotes.author: Johnny Depp

quotes.quote: Cynics are simply thwarted romantics.
quotes.author: William Goldman,  The Princess Bride

quotes.quote: It has always seemed strange to me...The things we admire in men, kindness and generosity, openness, honesty, understanding and feeling, are the concomitants of failure in our system. And those traits we detest, sharpness, greed, acquisitiveness, meanness, egotism and self-interest, are the traits of success. And while men admire the quality of the first they love the produce of the second.
quotes.author: John Steinbeck,  Cannery Row

quotes.quote: It was always the becoming he dreamed of, never the being.
quotes.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald,  This Side of Paradise

quotes.quote: When it's over, I want to say: all my lifeI was a bride married to amazement.I was the bridegroom, taking the world into my arms. When it is over, I don't want to wonderif I have made of my life something particular, and real.I don't want to find myself sighing and frightened,or full of argument. I don't want to end up simply having visited this world.
quotes.author: Mary Oliver

quotes.quote: It's not what you say out of your mouth that determines your life, it's what you whisper to yourself that has the most power!
quotes.author: Robert T. Kiyosaki

quotes.quote: There are ships sailing to many ports, but not a single one goes where life is not painful.
quotes.author: Fernando Pessoa,  The Book of Disquiet

quotes.quote: Earth's crammed with heaven...But only he who sees, takes off his shoes.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning,  Aurora Leigh

quotes.quote: I think that the best thing we can do for our children is to allow them to do things for themselves, allow them to be strong, allow them to experience life on their own terms, allow them to take the subway... let them be better people, let them believe more in themselves.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: It's never an insult to be called what somebody thinks is a bad name. It just shows you how poor that person is, it doesn't hurt you.
quotes.author: Harper Lee,  To Kill a Mockingbird

quotes.quote: If history remembers me at all, in any way, I hope it will be as a man who loved the Land of Israel and watched over it in every way he could, all his life.
quotes.author: Yitzhak Shamir

quotes.quote: Haters never win. I just think that's true about life, because negative energy always costs in the end.
quotes.author: Tom Hiddleston

quotes.quote: Of all creatures that breathe and move upon the earth, nothing is bred that is weaker than man.
quotes.author: Homer,  The Odyssey

quotes.quote: Most of the basic material a writer works with is acquired before the age of fifteen.
quotes.author: Willa Cather

quotes.quote: Knowledge, like air, is vital to life. Like air, no one should be denied it.
quotes.author: Alan Moore,  V for Vendetta

quotes.quote: I've learned in my life that it's important to be able to step outside your comfort zone and be challenged with something you're not familiar or accustomed to. That challenge will allow you to see what you can do.
quotes.author: J. R. Martinez

quotes.quote: If you've never eaten while crying you don t know what life tastes like.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.quote: There is nothing more frightful than ignorance in action.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe,  Collected Works

quotes.quote: There are no coincidences in life. What person that wandered in and out of your life was there for some purpose, even if they caused you harm. Sometimes, it doesn't make sense the short periods of time we get with people, or the outcomes from their choices. However, if you turn it over to God he promises that you will see the big picture in the hereafter. Nothing is too small to be a mistake.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: Meditation is to dive all the way within, beyond thought, to the source of thought and pure consciousness. It enlarges the container, every time you transcend. When you come out, you come out refreshed, filled with energy and enthusiasm for life.
quotes.author: David Lynch

quotes.quote: Nothing is as dangerous in architecture as dealing with separated problems. If we split life into separated problems we split the possibilities to make good building art.
quotes.author: Alvar Aalto

quotes.quote: Patience and wisdom walk hand in hand, like two one-armed lovers.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  $3.33

quotes.quote: At some point we all look up and realize we are lost in a maze.
quotes.author: John Green,  Looking for Alaska

quotes.quote: People say that eyes are windows to the soul.
quotes.author: Khaled Hosseini,  The Kite Runner

quotes.quote: I want words at my funeral. But I guess that means you need life in your life.
quotes.author: Markus Zusak,  The Book Thief

quotes.author: Sherrilyn Kenyon,  Kiss of the Night

quotes.quote: Most everything you think you know about me is nothing more than memories.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  A Wild Sheep Chase

quotes.quote: I seem to have run in a great circle, and met myself again on the starting line.
quotes.author: Jeanette Winterson,  Oranges Are Not the Only Fruit

quotes.quote: Personally, I don't like inherently happy people. I don't trust them. I think there's something seriously wrong with anyone who isn't at least a little let down by the world.
quotes.author: Tiffanie DeBartolo,  How to Kill a Rock Star

quotes.quote: After all, life hasn't much to offer except youth, and I suppose for older people, the love of youth in others.
quotes.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

quotes.quote: All opinions are not equal. Some are a very great deal more robust, sophisticated and well supported in logic and argument than others.
quotes.author: Douglas Adams,  The Salmon of Doubt

quotes.quote: Life, with its rules, its obligations, and its freedoms, is like a sonnet: You're given the form, but you have to write the sonnet yourself. - Mrs. Whatsit
quotes.author: Madeleine L'Engle,  A Wrinkle in Time

quotes.quote: Let today be the day you stop being haunted by the ghost of yesterday. Holding a grudge & harboring anger/resentment is poison to the soul. Get even with people...but not those who have hurt us, forget them, instead get even with those who have helped us.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: There was a moment in my life when I really wanted to kill myself. And there was one other moment when I was close to that. . . . But even in my most jaded times, I had some hope.
quotes.author: Gerard Way

quotes.quote: If you were to ask me the best time of day to fall in love, I'd say, "Now."But you'd also have to remember to factor in the fact that my watch is eleven minutes fast.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: How can I go forward when I don't know which way I'm facing?
quotes.author: John Lennon

quotes.quote: Do your own thing on your own terms and get what you came here for
quotes.author: Oliver James

quotes.quote: Medicine is not only a science; it is also an art. It does not consist of compounding pills and plasters; it deals with the very processes of life, which must be understood before they may be guided.
quotes.author: Paracelsus

quotes.quote: If your daily life seems poor, do not blame it; blame yourself, tell yourself that you are not poet enough to call forth its riches; for to the creator there is no poverty and no poor indifferent place.
quotes.author: Rainer Maria Rilke,  Letters to a Young Poet

quotes.quote: I've come to the conclusion that people who wear headphones while they walk, are much happier, more confident, and more beautiful individuals than someone making the solitary drudge to work without acknowledging their own interests and power.
quotes.author: Jason Mraz

quotes.quote: We should count time by heart-throbs. He most lives,Who thinks most, feels noblest, acts the best.
quotes.author: Philip James Bailey,  Festus: A Poem

quotes.quote: It is a very funny thing that the sleepier you are, the longer you take about getting to bed.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis,  The Silver Chair

quotes.quote: Transformation is my favorite game and in my experience, anger and frustration are the result of you not being authentic somewhere in your life or with someone in your life. Being fake about anything creates a block inside of you. Life can't work for you if you don't show up as you.
quotes.author: Jason Mraz

quotes.quote: You must give everything to make your life as beautiful as the dreams that dance in your imagination.
quotes.author: Roman Payne

quotes.quote: There is no passion to be found playing small - in settling for a life that is less than the one you are capable of living.
quotes.author: Nelson Mandela

quotes.quote: The great danger for family life, in the midst of any society whose idols are pleasure, comfort and independence, lies in the fact that people close their hearts and become selfish.
quotes.author: Pope John Paul II

quotes.quote: I am always sad, I think. Perhaps this signifies that I am not sad at all, because sadness is something lower than your normal disposition, and I am always the same thing. Perhaps I am the only person in the world, then, who never becomes sad. Perhaps I am lucky.
quotes.author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Everything Is Illuminated

quotes.quote: Live life fully while you're here. Experience everything. Take care of yourself and your friends. Have fun, be crazy, be weird. Go out and screw up! You're going to anyway, so you might as well enjoy the process. Take the opportunity to learn from your mistakes: find the cause of your problem and eliminate it. Don't try to be perfect; just be an excellent example of being human.
quotes.author: Anthony Robbins

quotes.quote: You made me feel alive again.
quotes.author: Julie Kagawa,  The Iron King

quotes.quote: I am not the same having seen the moon shine on the other side of the world.
quotes.author: Mary Anne Radmacher

quotes.quote: To look life in the face, always, to look life in the face, and to know it for what it is...at last, to love it for what it is, and then, to put it away...
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf

quotes.quote: Hardships make or break people.
quotes.author: Margaret Mitchell,  Gone with the Wind

quotes.quote: Closed in a room, my imagination becomes the universe, and the rest of the world is missing out.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Diotima, Battery, Electric Personality

quotes.quote: Love is like whoa! Actually, it's closer to woe.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Love quotes for the ages. Specifically ages 18-81.

quotes.quote: It doesn't matter what you did or where you were...it matters where you are and what you're doing. Get out there! Sing the song in your heart and NEVER let anyone shut you up!!
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: The human race tends to remember the abuses to which it has been subjected rather than the endearments. What's left of kisses? Wounds, however, leave scars.
quotes.author: Bertolt Brecht

quotes.quote: I don't want to live, I want to love first and live incidentally.
quotes.author: Zelda Fitzgerald

quotes.quote: Walk with the dreamers, the believers, the courageous, the cheerful, the planners, the doers, the successful people with their heads in the clouds and their feet on the ground. Let their spirit ignite a fire within you to leave this world better than when you found it...
quotes.author: Wilferd Peterson

quotes.quote: Life is nothing without a little chaos to make it interesting.
quotes.author: Amelia Atwater-Rhodes,  Demon in My View

quotes.quote: Hope is a feeling that life and work have meaning. You either have it or you don't, regardless of the state of the world that surrounds you.
quotes.author: Vaclav Havel

quotes.quote: A man cannot be said to succeed in this life who does not satisfy one friend.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.quote: It is a good rule in life never to apologize. The right sort of people do not want apologies, and the wrong sort take a mean advantage of them.
quotes.author: P.G. Wodehouse,  The Man Upstairs and Other Stories

quotes.quote: No single event can awaken within us a stranger whose existence we had never suspected. To live is to be slowly born.

quotes.quote: There will be time, there will be timeTo prepare a face to meet the faces that you meet.

quotes.quote: Too often we underestimate the power of a touch, a smile, a kind word, alistening ear, an honest compliment, or the smallest act of caring, allof which have the potential to turn a life around.

quotes.quote: To be rejected by someone doesn't mean you should also reject yourself or that you should think of yourself as a lesser person. It doesn't mean that nobody will ever love you anymore. Remember that only ONE person has rejected you at the moment, and it only hurt so much because to you, that person's opinion symbolized the opinion of the whole world, of God.
quotes.author: Jocelyn Soriano,  Mend My Broken Heart

quotes.quote: At a time when unbridled greed, malignant aggression, and existence of weapons of mass destruction threatens the survival of humanity, we should seriously consider any avenue that offers some hope.
quotes.author: Stanislav Grof

quotes.quote: One of the things I learned the hard way was that it doesn't pay to get discouraged. Keeping busy and making optimism a way of life can restore your faith in yourself.
quotes.author: Lucille Ball

quotes.quote: After all, what's a life, anyway? We're born, we live a little while, we die.
quotes.author: E.B. White,  Charlotte's Web

quotes.quote: One of the most spiritual things you can do is embrace your humanity. Connect with those around you today. Say, "I love you", "I'm sorry", "I appreciate you", "I'm proud of you"...whatever you're feeling. Send random texts, write a cute note, embrace your truth and share it...cause a smile today for someone else...and give plenty of hugs.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: ...nothing ever happens quickly (except when it does). Nothing is ever, ever easy (except when it is). And, most of all, nothing ever goes perfectly according to plan (except in the movies).
quotes.author: Ally Carter,  Only the Good Spy Young

quotes.quote: You need to find a way to live your life, that it doesn't make a mockery of your values.
quotes.author: Bill Ayers

quotes.quote: The only gift I have to give, is the ability to receive. If giving is a gift, and it surely is, then my gift to you is to allow you to give to me.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  The Titanic would never have sunk if it were made out of a sink.

quotes.quote: If I were a tree, I would have no reason to love a human.

quotes.quote: Dare I say I miss him? I do. I miss him. I still see him in my dreams. They are nightmares mostly, but nightmares tinged with love.I still cannot understand how he could abandon me so unceremoniously, without any sort of goodbye, without looking back even once. That pain is like an axe that chops at my heart.
quotes.author: Yann Martel,  Life of Pi

quotes.quote: I'm willing to die for the woman I love. I just want to take 75 years to do it.

quotes.quote: We demand rigidly defined areas of doubt and uncertainty!

quotes.quote: I have learned that you can go anywhere you want to go and do anything you want to do and buy all the things that you want to buy and meet all the people that you want to meet and learn all the things that you desire to learn and if you do all these things but are not madly in love: you have still not begun to live.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: When you encourage others, you in the process are encouraged because you're making a commitment and difference in that person's life. Encouragement really does make a difference.
quotes.author: Zig Ziglar

quotes.quote: There is no time for cut-and-dried monotony. There is time for work. And time for love. That leaves no other time.
quotes.author: Coco Chanel

quotes.quote: If you want to identify me, ask me not where I live, or what I like to eat, or how I comb my hair, but ask me what I am living for, in detail, ask me what I think is keeping me from living fully for the thing I want to live for.
quotes.author: Thomas Merton

quotes.quote: You made me confess the fears that I have. But I will tell you also what I do not fear. I do not fear to be alone or to be spurned for another or to leave whatever I have to leave. And I am not afraid to make a mistake, even a great mistake, a lifelong mistake and perhaps as long as eternity too.
quotes.author: James Joyce,  A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man

quotes.quote: You are -- your life, and nothing else.
quotes.author: Jean-Paul Sartre,  No Exit

quotes.quote: If you live each day as it was your last, someday you'll most certainly be right
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.quote: The aim of life is self-development. To realize one's nature perfectly - that is what each of us is here for.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Look. I have a strategy. Why expect anything? If you don't expect anything, you don't get disappointed.
quotes.author: Patricia McCormick,  Cut

quotes.quote: People tend to be generous when sharing their nonsense, fear, and ignorance. And while they seem quite eager to feed you their negativity, please remember that sometimes the diet we need to be on is a spiritual and emotional one. Be cautious with what you feed your mind and soul. Fuel yourself with positivity and let that fuel propel you into positive action.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: I have discovered in life that there are ways of getting almost anywhere you want to go, if you really want to go.
quotes.author: Langston Hughes

quotes.quote: We leave something of ourselves behind when we leave a place, we stay there, even though we go away. And there are things in us that we can find again only by going back there.

quotes.quote: Don't try to hog loneliness and keep it all to yourself. Share it with a special someone.

quotes.quote: You were made by God and for God and until you understand that, life will never make sense.
quotes.author: Rick Warren

quotes.author: Leonard Cohen

The beautiful ghosts of our past haunt us, and yet we still can't decide if the pain they caused us out weighs the tender moments when they touched our soul. This is the irony of love.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: I think it's impossible to really understand somebody, what they want, what they believe, and not love them the way they love themselves.
quotes.author: Orson Scott Card,  Ender's Game

quotes.author: Chris Kyle

quotes.quote: To each there comes in their lifetime a special moment when they are figuratively tapped on the shoulder and offered the chance to do a very special thing, unique to them and fitted to their talents. What a tragedy if that moment finds them unprepared or unqualified for that which could have been their finest hour.
quotes.author: Winston S. Churchill

quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Committed: A Skeptic Makes Peace with Marriage

Told to others, but--mainly--to ourselves.
quotes.author: Julian Barnes,  The Sense of an Ending

quotes.author: Dorothea Lange

quotes.quote: Life, although it may only be an accumulation of anguish, is dear to me, and I will defend it.
quotes.author: Mary Shelley,  Frankenstein

quotes.quote: Those who hurt others will also hurt themselves.
quotes.author: Natsuki Takaya

quotes.quote: All knowledge is worth having.
quotes.author: Jacqueline Carey,  Kushiel's Dart

quotes.quote: Quiet is peace. Tranquility. Quiet is turning down the volume knob on life. Silence is pushing the off button. Shutting it down. All of it. - Amir
quotes.author: Khaled Hosseini,  The Kite Runner

quotes.author: Chris Farley

quotes.quote: I don't write literary fiction - I write books that are entertaining, but are also, I hope, well-constructed and thoughtful and funny and have things to say about men and women and families and children and life in America today.
quotes.author: Jennifer Weiner

quotes.quote: The moment we begin to fear the opinions of others and hesitate to tell the truth that is in us, and from motives of policy are silent when we should speak, the divine floods of light and life no longer flow into our souls.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Cady Stanton

quotes.quote: Is this thing safe?""Safe as life,"Gansey replied.
quotes.author: Maggie Stiefvater,  The Raven Boys

quotes.author: Neil Gaiman,  The Graveyard Book

quotes.quote: Souls cross ages like clouds cross skies, an' tho' a cloud's shape nor hue nor size don't stay the same, it's still a cloud an' so is a soul. Who can say where the cloud's blowed from or who the soul'll be 'morrow? Only Sonmi the east an' the west an' the compass an' the atlas, yay, only the atlas o' clouds.
quotes.author: David Mitchell,  Cloud Atlas

quotes.quote: I'm not bothered about what people say behind my back. I don't need to know about it. I believe in living my life and doing my work. God will give you success. And even if He doesn't, there's a lesson to be learnt.
quotes.author: Rani Mukerji

quotes.quote: The value of life is not in its duration, but in its donation. You are not important because of how long you live, you are important because of how effective you live.
quotes.author: Myles Munroe

quotes.quote: You can't be brave if you've only had wonderful things happen to you.
quotes.author: Mary Tyler Moore

quotes.quote: Before, I wanted to say: "I found love!"But now, I want to say: "I found a person. And he belongs to me and I belong to him.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: I was in the biggest breakdown of my life when I stopped crying long enough to let the words of my epiphany really sink in. That whore, karma, had finally made her way around, and had just bitch-slapped me right across the face. The realization only made me cry harder.
quotes.author: Jennifer Salaiz

quotes.quote: The beautiful journey of today can only begin when we learn to let go of yesterday.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Madame, all stories, if continued far enough, end in death, and he is no true-story teller who would keep that from you.
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway

quotes.quote: The cost of a thing is the amount of what I will call life which is required to be exchanged for it, immediately or in the long run.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau,  Walden

quotes.quote: I am a great admirer of mystery and magic. Look at this life - all mystery and magic.
quotes.author: Harry Houdini

quotes.quote: Don't walk in front of me, I may not follow. Don't walk behind me, I may not lead. There is only one happiness in life, to love and be loved.
quotes.author: George Sand

quotes.quote: The object of life is not to be on the side of the majority, but to escape finding oneself in the ranks of the insane.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius,  Meditations

quotes.quote: Unrequited love is the infinite curse of a lonely heart.
quotes.author: Christina Westover

quotes.quote: You are someone who is different, but who wants to be the same as everyone else. And that in my view is a serious illness. God chose you to be different. Why are you disappointing God with this kind of attitude?
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  Veronika Decides to Die

quotes.quote: If you enter this world knowing you are loved and you leave this world knowing the same, then everything that happens in between can be dealt with.
quotes.author: Michael Jackson

quotes.quote: Stairs, are they going up or are they going down? They're so confusing! If love were a physical thing, it would be stairs.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Love quotes for the ages. Specifically ages 18-81.

quotes.quote: The hardest thing about the road not taken is that you never know where it might have led.
quotes.author: Lisa Wingate,  A Month of Summer

quotes.quote: If you can't save your own life, is it even worth saving?
quotes.author: Rainbow Rowell,  Eleanor & Park

quotes.quote: Our battered suitcases were piled on the sidewalk again; we had longer ways to go. But no matter, the road is life
quotes.author: Jack Kerouac,  On the Road

quotes.quote: The ideal life is in our blood and never will be still.
quotes.author: Phillips Brooks

quotes.quote: Learn to enjoy every minute of your life. Be happy now. Don't wait for something outside of yourself to make you happy in the future. Think how really precious is the time you have to spend, whether it's at work or with your family. Every minute should be enjoyed and savored.
quotes.author: Earl Nightingale

quotes.quote: Like Alexander the Great and Caesar, I'm out to conquer the world. But first I have to stop at Walmart and pick up some supplies.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  The Titanic would never have sunk if it were made out of a sink.

quotes.quote: Hearing voices no one else can hear isn't a good sign, even in the wizarding world.
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

quotes.quote: A single death is a tragedy; a million deaths is a statistic.
quotes.author: Joseph Stalin

quotes.quote: The best stories don't come from "good vs. bad"but "good vs. good.
quotes.author: Leo Tolstoy

quotes.quote: Not on one strand are all life's jewels strung.
quotes.author: William Morris

quotes.quote: I feel that the simplicity of life is just being yourself.
quotes.author: Bobby Brown

quotes.quote: The way to know life is to love many things.
quotes.author: Vincent Van Gogh

quotes.quote: Sometimes I just think depression's one way of coping with the world. Like, some people get drunk, some people do drugs, some people get depressed. Because there's so much stuff out there that you have to do something to deal with it.
quotes.author: Ned Vizzini,  It's Kind of a Funny Story

quotes.quote: The universe may not always play fair, but at least it's got a hell of a sense of humor.
quotes.author: Candace Bushnell,  Sex and the City

quotes.quote: The mistakes I've made are dead to me. But I can't take back the things I never did.
quotes.author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close

quotes.quote: Wisdom is having things right in your lifeand knowing why.
quotes.author: William Stafford

quotes.quote: If you don't live a life in service of a greater good, you've gotta at least die a death in service of a greater good, you know? And I fear that I won't get either a life or a death that means anything.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: The world changes, we do not, therein lies the irony that kills us.
quotes.author: Anne Rice,  Interview with the Vampire

quotes.quote: It does not matter how long you are spending on the earth, how much money you have gathered or how much attention you have received. It is the amount of positive vibration you have radiated in life that matters,
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Meditation: Insights and Inspirations

quotes.quote: It's strange how dreams get under your skin and give your heart a test for what's real and what's imaginary.
quotes.author: Jason Mraz

quotes.quote: It's no good trying to get rid of your own aloneness. You've got to stick to it all your life. Only at times, at times, the gap will be filled in. At times! But you have to wait for the times. Accept your own aloneness and stick to it, all your life. And then accept the times when the gap is filled in, when they come. But they've got to come. You can't force them.
quotes.author: D.H. Lawrence,  Lady Chatterley's Lover

quotes.quote: It's not hard to decide what you want your life to be about. What's hard, she said, is figuring out what you're willing to give up in order to do the things you really care about.
quotes.author: Shauna Niequist,  Bittersweet: Thoughts on Change, Grace, and Learning the Hard Way

quotes.quote: Hard is trying to rebuild yourself, piece by piece, with no instruction book, and no clue as to where all the important bits are supposed to go.
quotes.author: Nick Hornby,  A Long Way Down

quotes.quote: We are unusual and tragic and alive.
quotes.author: Dave Eggers

quotes.quote: Never forget that anticipation is an important part of life. Work's important, family's important, but without excitement, you have nothing. You're cheating yourself if you refuse to enjoy what's coming.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  Three Weeks With My Brother

quotes.quote: Those who will not reason, are bigots, those who cannot, are fools, and those who dare not, are slaves.
quotes.author: George Gordon Byron

quotes.quote: Don't own so much clutter that you will be relieved to see your house catch fire.
quotes.author: Wendell Berry,  Farming: a hand book

quotes.quote: Writing is a form of therapy; sometimes I wonder how all those who do not write, compose, or paint can manage to escape the madness, melancholia, the panic and fear which is inherent in a human situation.
quotes.author: Graham Greene,  Ways Of Escape

quotes.quote: There are a lot of things I wish I would have done, instead of just sitting around and complaining about having a boring life.
quotes.author: Kurt Cobain

quotes.quote: And therein lies the whole of man's plight. Human time does not turn in a circle; it runs ahead in a straight line. That is why man cannot be happy: happiness is the longing for repetition.
quotes.author: Milan Kundera,  The Unbearable Lightness of Being

quotes.quote: I am convinced that most people do not grow up...We marry and dare to have children and call that growing up. I think what we do is mostly grow old. We carry accumulation of years in our bodies, and on our faces, but generally our real selves, the children inside, are innocent and shy as magnolias.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou,  Letter to My Daughter

quotes.quote: I thought doing reality TV would be the greatest success of my life or the biggest mistake.
quotes.author: Bethenny Frankel

quotes.quote: Berterimakasihlah pada segala yang memberi kehidupan.
quotes.author: Pramoedya Ananta Toer,  Bumi Manusia

quotes.quote: Let me give you a tip on a clue to men's characters: the man who damns money has obtained it dishonorably; the man who respects it has earned it.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand,  Atlas Shrugged

quotes.quote: I won't tell you that the world matters nothing, or the world's voice, or the voice of society. They matter a good deal. They matter far too much. But there are moments when one has to choose between living one's own life, fully, entirely, completely--or dragging out some false, shallow, degrading existence that the world in its hypocrisy demands. You have that moment now. Choose!
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Life is hard. After all, it kills you.
quotes.author: Katharine Hepburn,  Me: Stories of My Life

quotes.quote: My past has not defined me, destroyed me, deterred me, or defeated me; it has only strengthened me.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: I would pour you a glass of wine, but wouldn't it be more romantic if you sipped it out of my armpit?
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  A Story That Talks about Talking Is Like Chatter to Chattering Teeth, and Every Set of Dentures Can Attest to the Fact That No..

quotes.quote: Sense of humor is important in life, not just in clothing. How boring to live a life in beige.
quotes.author: Jean Pigozzi

quotes.quote: I don't know why we are here, but I'm pretty sure that it is not in order to enjoy ourselves.
quotes.author: Ludwig Wittgenstein

quotes.author: Shel Silverstein,  Where the Sidewalk Ends: The Poems and Drawings of Shel Silverstein

quotes.quote: It didn't make you noble to step away from something that wasn't working, even if you thought you were the reason for the malfunction. Especially then. It just made you a quitter. quotes.author: Cormac McCarthy,  The Road

quotes.quote: Life is filled with unanswered questions, but it is the courage to seek those answers that continues to give meaning to life. quotes.author: H. Jackson Brown, Jr.

quotes.quote: It can only take a moment to waste the rest of your life.
quotes.author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Snuff

quotes.author: Jane Green,  Bookends

quotes.quote: To sell your soul is the easiest thing in the world. That's what everybody does every hour of his life. If I asked you to keep your soul - would you understand why that's much harder?
quotes.author: Ayn Rand,  The Fountainhead

quotes.quote: Between hello and goodbye is I love you.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  99 Cents For Some Nonsense

quotes.quote: I wish to weepbut sorrow isstupid.I wish to believebut belief is agraveyard.
quotes.author: Charles Bukowski,  What Matters Most is How Well You Walk Through the Fire

quotes.author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Everything Is Illuminated

quotes.quote: Love is energy of life.

quotes.quote: Want to keep Christ in Christmas? Feed the hungry, clothe the naked, forgive the guilty, welcome the unwanted, care for the ill, love your enemies, and do unto others as you would have done unto you.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Life is more or less a lie, but then again, that's exactly the way we want it to be.
quotes.author: Bob Dylan

quotes.quote: Life is a blank canvas, and you need to throw all the paint on it you can.
quotes.author: Danny Kaye

quotes.quote: The cost of oblivious daydreaming was always this moment of return, the realignment with what had been before and now seemed a little worse.
quotes.author: Ian McEwan,  Atonement

quotes.quote: People who lack the clarity, courage, or determination to follow their own dreams will often find ways to discourage yours. When you change for the better, the people around you will be inspired to change also....but only after doing their best to make you stop. Live your truth and don't EVER stop.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: We should forgive our enemies, but not before they are hanged

quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  I Want

quotes.quote: Life is a succession of lessons which must be lived to be understood.

quotes.quote: Be still, sad heart! and cease repining;Behind the clouds is the sun still shining;Thy fate is the common fate of all,Into each life some rain must fall

quotes.quote: Life is full of misery, loneliness, and suffering - and it's all over much too soon.
quotes.author: Woody Allen

quotes.quote: The best way to predict your future is to create it
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.author: Jerry Spinelli,  Stargirl

We make all sorts of assumptions because we don't have the courage to ask questions.

quotes.quote: The tragedy of life is what dies inside a man while he lives.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: I've got a way with love. Away with love.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Love quotes for the ages. Specifically ages 18-81.

quotes.quote: The beautiful is always bizarre.

quotes.author: Robert Green Ingersoll

quotes.author: Zora Neale Hurston

quotes.quote: People wait around too long for love. I'm happy with all of my lusts!
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: Would you rather live one perfect day over and over or live your life with no perfect days but just decent ones?
quotes.author: Jenny Han,  The Summer I Turned Pretty

quotes.quote: I'm not saying it's going to be easy. Nothing in life is easy. But that's no reason to give up. You'll be surprised what you can accomplish if you set your mind to it. After all, you only have one life, so you should try to make the most of it.
quotes.author: Louis Sachar

quotes.author: D. Simone

quotes.quote: One does no question miracles, or complain that they are no constructed perfectly to one's liking.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Princess

quotes.quote: Is life not a thousand times too short for us to bore ourselves?
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Love flows like flowers, and grows like water. I'm so thirsty for romance I could drink a dozen roses.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Every woman that finally figured out her worth, has picked up her suitcases of pride and boarded a flight to freedom, which landed in the valley of change.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: 0 plus 100 equals 100. But so does 50 plus 50, only with more balance. Let this be a lesson in love.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

I could be anywhere, and since I can't describe myself I can't ask for help.
quotes.author: Jeanette Winterson,  Sexing the Cherry

quotes.quote: I used to think the worst thing in life is to end up all alone. It's not. The worst thing in life is to end up with people who make you feel all alone.
quotes.author: Robin Williams

quotes.quote: How quick come the reasons for approving what we like.
quotes.author: Jane Austen,  Persuasion

quotes.quote: I want to be around people that do things. I don't want to be around people anymore that judge or talk about what people do. I want to be around people that dream and support and do things.
quotes.author: Amy Poehler

quotes.quote: Just when I think I have learned the way to live, life changes.
quotes.author: Hugh Prather

quotes.author: Philip K. Dick,  Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?

quotes.author: Daphne du Maurier,  Rebecca

quotes.author: Albert Camus,  The Myth of Sisyphus and Other Essays

quotes.quote: Life was always a matter of waiting for the right moment to act.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho

quotes.author: Steve Aoki

I am going to write fire until it comes out of my ears, my eyes, my noseholes--everywhere. Until it's every breath I breathe. I'm going to go out like a fucking meteor!
quotes.author: Audre Lorde

quotes.quote: All the stuff you can't wait to get away from, until it's not there anymore, and then you miss it like crazy.
quotes.author: Morgan Matson,  Since You've Been Gone

quotes.quote: it takes as much courage to have tried and failed as it does to have tried and succeded.
quotes.author: Anne Morrow Lindbergh

quotes.quote: Dying is only one thing to be sad over. Living unhappily is something else.
quotes.author: Mitch Albom,  Tuesdays with Morrie

quotes.quote: When you lost sight of your path, listen for the destination in your heart (Allen Walker, D-gray Man)
quotes.author: Katsura Hoshino

quotes.quote: Love doesn't have to be on Valentine's Day. It doesn't have to be by the time you turn eighteen or thirty-three or fifty-nine. It doesn't have to conform to whatever is usual. It doesn't have to be kismet at once, or rhapsody by the third day.It just has to be. In time. In place. In spirt.It just has to be.
quotes.author: David Levithan,  How They Met, and Other Stories

quotes.quote: People die all the time. Life is a lot more fragile than we think. So you should treat others in a way that leaves no regrets. Fairly, and if possible, sincerely. It's too easy not to make the effort, then weep and wring your hands after the person dies.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  Dance Dance Dance

quotes.quote: The world is wide, and I will not waste my life in friction when it could be turned into momentum.
quotes.author: Frances E. Willard

quotes.quote: Whatever happens to your body, your soul will survive, untouched...
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

quotes.quote: I used to believe that people are only born once, but now I feel I have been reborn, like I was given a new life. I see myself as a child, full of energy and hope.
quotes.author: Bahman Ghobadi

quotes.quote: If you plan on being anything less than you are capable of being, you will probably be unhappy all the days of your life.
quotes.author: Abraham Maslow

quotes.quote: What keeps life fascinating is the constant creativity of the soul.
quotes.author: Deepak Chopra,  Life After Death: The Burden of Proof

quotes.quote: I have a deeply hidden and inarticulate desire for something beyond the daily life.
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf,  Moments of Being

quotes.quote: If there be light, then there is darkness; if cold, heat; if height, depth; if solid, fluid; if hard, soft; if rough, smooth; if calm, tempest; if prosperity, adversity; if life, death.
quotes.author: Pythagoras

quotes.quote: All those who try to unveil the mysteries always have tragic lives. At the end they are always punished.
quotes.author: AnaÃ¯s Nin

quotes.quote: It's amazing how quickly nature consumes human places after we turn our backs on them. Life is a hungry thing.
quotes.author: Scott Westerfeld,  Peeps

quotes.quote: What kind of life can you have in a house without books?
quotes.author: Sherman Alexie,  Flight

quotes.quote: My eyes were glued on lifeand they were full of tears.
quotes.author: Jack Kerouac,  Atop an Underwood: Early Stories and Other Writings

quotes.quote: Those who have failed to work toward the truth have missed the purpose of living.
quotes.author: Gautama Buddha

quotes.quote: The spiritual life does not remove us from the world but leads us deeper into it
quotes.author: Henri J.M. Nouwen

quotes.quote: I want you. I want you so badly I can't stand it. When you left, it felt like the world got darker. Like I couldn't truly see anything. Couldn't feel anything.
quotes.author: Rachel Vincent,  Alpha

quotes.quote: Something amazing happens when you're in love and don't give a damn about what day it is anymore.
quotes.author: Chad Sugg

quotes.quote: The heart makes its choices without weighing the consequences. It doesn't look ahead to the lonely nights that follow.
quotes.author: Tess Gerritsen,  Keeping The Dead

quotes.quote: I used to wonder if it was God's plan that I should be alone for so much of my life. But I found peace. I found happiness within people and the world.
quotes.author: Lana Del Rey

quotes.quote: Sometimes when you least expect it, the tables turn and that scary feeling that has taken hold of you for so long somehow turns into hope
quotes.author: David Archuleta,  Chords of Strength: A Memoir of Soul, Song and the Power of Perseverance

quotes.quote: The direction of your focus is the direction your life will move. Let yourself move toward what is good, valuable, strong and true.
quotes.author: Ralph Marston

quotes.quote: Life is life. You choose to live it or you do not.
quotes.author: Carrie Ryan,  The Dead-Tossed Waves

quotes.quote: We have to lie to ourselves to live. Otherwise, we'd go crazy.
quotes.author: Patrick Ness,  More Than This

quotes.quote: All this twaddle, the existence of God, atheism, determinism, liberation, societies, death, etc., are pieces of a chess game called language, and they are amusing only if one does not preoccupy oneself with 'winning or losing this game of chess.
quotes.author: Marcel Duchamp

quotes.quote: Life is so beautiful that death has fallen in love with it, a jealous possessive love that grabs at what it can.
quotes.author: Yann Martel,  Life of Pi

quotes.quote: Mom always liked to say that we hardly ever know the decisions we make that change our lives, mostly because they are little ones. You took this bus instead of that one and ended up meeting your soul mate, that kind of thing. But there was no doubt in my mind that this was one of those life-changing moments.
quotes.author: Rachel Hawkins,  Demonglass

quotes.quote: Everybody's damaged by something.
quotes.author: Emma Donoghue,  Room

quotes.quote: Nostalgia in reverse, the longing for yet another strange land, grew especially strong in spring.
quotes.author: Vladimir Nabokov,  Mary

quotes.quote: It takes guts to love with gusto. Most people love as if they wish they were invisible, and then they wonder why their affections go unnoticed.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Besides the noble art of getting things done, there is the noble art of leaving things undone. The wisdom of life consists in the elimination of non-essentials.
quotes.author: Lin Yutang,  The Importance of Living

quotes.quote: The biggest changes in a women's nature are brought by love; in man, by ambition
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.quote: Everyone is lonely, we have to remember that life is to be lived one day at a time. You cannot worry about the past or future. Happiness is in the now.
quotes.author: Claudia Gray

quotes.quote: The heart may freeze, or it can burn. The pain will ease and I can learn. There is no future, there is no past. I live this moment as, my last.
quotes.author: Jonathan Larson,  Rent: The Complete Book and Lyrics of the Broadway Musical

quotes.quote: It would be so nice if something made sense for a change.
quotes.author: Lewis Carroll

quotes.quote: Sometimes it's the same moments that take your breath away that breathe purpose and love back into your life.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Apparently I'm transparent--with my feelings, not with my body. I'm an emotional ghost, and if you can't see my love for you it's because it's dead.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: It is a fine thing to establish one's own religion in one's heart, not to be dependent on tradition and second-hand ideals. Life will seem to you, later, not a lesser, but a greater thing.
quotes.author: D.H. Lawrence

quotes.author: Stephen King,  The Drawing of the Three

quotes.quote: It's not so much the journey that's important; as is the way that we treat those we encounter and those around us, along the way
quotes.author: Jeremy Aldana

quotes.quote: Life is not to be taken seriously, as we are really temporary here. We are like a pre-paid card with limited validity. If we are lucky, we may last another 50 years. And 50 years is just 2,500 weekends. Do we really need to get so worked up? It's ok, bunk a few classes, goof up a few interviews, fall in love. We are people, not programmed devices.
quotes.author: Chetan Bhagat

quotes.quote: Maybe the truth was, it shouldn't be so easy to be amazing. Then everything would be. It's the things you fight for and struggle with before earning that have the greatest worth. When something's difficult to come by, you'll do that much more to make sure it's even harder--if not impossible--to lose.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  Along for the Ride

quotes.quote: Find someone who has a life that you want and figure out how they got it. Read books, pick your role models wisely. Find out what they did and do it.
quotes.author: Lana Del Rey

quotes.author: P.L. Deshpande

quotes.quote: Never compromise your values.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: When I think about the kind of guy I want to marry, I think I might prefer someone who knows where they are going. I mean a prince pretty much has his whole life planned out already, doesn't he? And this is important because I have no idea where I'm going or what I want to do with my life.
quotes.author: Jillian Dodd,  That Boy

quotes.quote: The great thing, if one can, is to stop regarding all the unpleasant things as interruptions of one's 'own,' or 'real' life. The truth is of course that what one calls the interruptions are precisely one's real life -- the life God is sending one day by day.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis,  The Collected Works of C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: ... In love, everyone does things that hurt the other person, so there really is no "Right"and "Wrong". You just have to decide what you're willing to forgive
quotes.author: Yvonne Wood,  Dead Beautiful
