quotes.quote: If you want small changes in your life, work on your attitude. But if you want big and primary changes, work on your paradigm.
quotes.author: Stephen Covey

quotes.quote: Whoever said that the past isn't dead had it backward. It's the future that's already dead, already played out.
quotes.author: Gayle Forman,  Where She Went

quotes.quote: My formula for life is very simple: in the morning, wake up; at night, go to sleep. In between I try and occupy myself as best I can.
quotes.author: Cary Grant

quotes.quote: There are times I wish I were invisible. Which is silly, since I do everything I can to stand out.
quotes.author: Gena Showalter,  Oh My Goth

quotes.quote: I began to understand that suffering and disappointments and melancholy are there not to vex us or cheapen us or deprive us of our dignity but to mature and transfigure us.
quotes.author: Hermann Hesse,  Peter Camenzind

quotes.quote: Quietly endure, silently suffer and patiently wait.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King Jr.,  Why We Can't Wait

quotes.quote: The thing about being catapulted into a whole new life--or at least, shoved up so hard against someone else's life that you might as well have your face pressed against their window--is that it forces you to rethink your idea of who you are. Or how you might seem to other people.
quotes.author: Jojo Moyes,  Me Before You

quotes.quote: Lottery: A tax on people who are bad at math.
quotes.author: Ambrose Bierce

quotes.quote: Why not just live in the moment, especially if it has a good beat?
quotes.author: Goldie Hawn

quotes.quote: I had a dream about you last night... you were a giant slinky and I watched you fall down the stairs.
quotes.author: Amy Summers,  I Had a Dream About You

quotes.quote: Give me strength, not to be better than my enemies, but to defeat my greatest enemy, the doubts within myself. Give me strength for a straight back and clear eyes, so when life fades, as the setting sun, my spirit may come to you without shame.
quotes.author: P.C. Cast

quotes.quote: If you fuel your journey on the opinions of others, you are going to run out of gas.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Life is so full of unpredictable beauty and strange surprises. Sometimes that beauty is too much for me to handle. Do you know that feeling? When something is just too beautiful? When someone says something or writes something or plays something that moves you to the point of tears, maybe even changes you.
quotes.author: Mark Oliver Everett,  Things The Grandchildren Should Know

quotes.quote: I want to write a book so long that it will take the average person their whole life to read. It will be exactly the same length as the Bible.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  I Want

quotes.quote: Slow down and enjoy life. It's not only the scenery you miss by going too fast - you also miss the sense of where you are going and why.
quotes.author: Eddie Cantor

quotes.quote: People don't always want to be with people. It gets tiring.
quotes.author: Emma Donoghue,  Room

quotes.quote: They know that tragedy is not glamorous. They know it doesn't play out in life as it does on a stage or between the pages of a book. It is neither a punishment meted out nor a lesson conferred. Its horrors are not attributable to one single person. Tragedy is ugly and tangled, stupid and confusing.
quotes.author: E. Lockhart,  We Were Liars

quotes.quote: But what is life if you don't live it?
quotes.author: James Patterson,  Suzanne's Diary for Nicholas

quotes.quote: Do you wake up as I do, having forgotten what it is that hurts or where, until you move? There is a second of consciousness that is clean again. A second that is you, without memory or experience, the animal warm and waking into a brand new world. There is the sun dissolving the dark, and light as clear as music, filling the room where you sleep and the other rooms behind your eyes.
quotes.author: Jeanette Winterson

quotes.quote: Well, I can understand how you feel. You worked hard, studying for the spelling bee, and I suppose you feel you let everyone down, and you made a fool of yourself and everything. But did you notice something, Charlie Brown?""What's that?""The world didn't come to an end.
quotes.author: Charles M. Schulz

quotes.quote: Life is a winking light in the darkness.
quotes.author: Hayao Miyazaki

quotes.quote: It's not always easy being her daughter.' I think,' she said, 'sometimes it's hard no matter whose daughter you are.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  Along for the Ride

quotes.quote: The reason why the universe is eternal is that it does not live for itself; it gives life to others as it transforms.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.quote: There Are Two Typos Of People In This World: Those Who Can Edit And Those Who Can't
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  There are Two Typos of People in This World: Those Who Can Edit and Those Who Can't

quotes.quote: Real life? Well, I just hope mine isn't investigated. They might find that I don't really exist - that I'm just a hologram.
quotes.author: Steven Wright

quotes.quote: The details are details. They make the product. The connections, the connections, the connections. It will in the end be these details that give the product its life.
quotes.author: Charles Eames

quotes.quote: It doesn't matter who you are, or where you come from, or how much money you've got in your pocket. You have your own destiny and your own life ahead of you.
quotes.author: Lady Gaga

quotes.quote: Some things in life are too complicated to explain in any language.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  Colorless Tsukuru Tazaki and His Years of Pilgrimage

quotes.quote: Sometimes letting go is simply changing the labels you place on an event. Looking at the same event with fresh eyes.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Each new day is a blank page in the diary of your life. The secret of success is in turning that diary into the best story you possibly can.
quotes.author: Douglas Pagels

quotes.quote: Love yourself. Forgive yourself. Be true to yourself. How you treat yourself sets the standard for how others will treat you.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Tristan was silent for a few moments, looking at the leaves before them. "Life isn't about the past and the future. It's about today."He paused. "It's about five minutes from now and two seconds ago. It's moments, you know? Not years. Years aren't what define us.
quotes.author: Chelsea Fine,  Anew

quotes.quote: Contrary to what you may assume, I am not a pessimist but an indifferentist- that is, I don't make the mistake of thinking that the... cosmos... gives a damn one way or the other about the especial wants and ultimate welfare of mosquitoes, rats, lice, dogs, men, horses, pterodactyls, trees, fungi, dodos, or other forms of biological energy.
quotes.author: H.P. Lovecraft

quotes.quote: There is no thing as a single-issue struggle because we do not live single-issue lives.
quotes.author: Audre Lorde

quotes.quote: Tried living in the real world instead of a shell, but I was bored before I even began.
quotes.author: Morrissey

quotes.quote: You don't put your life into your books, you find it there.
quotes.author: Alan Bennett,  The Uncommon Reader

quotes.quote: Count your blessings. Once you realize how valuable you are and how much you have going for you, the smiles will return, the sun will break out, the music will play, and you will finally be able to move forward the life that God intended for you with grace, strength, courage, and confidence.
quotes.author: Og Mandino

quotes.quote: You're here to be light, bringing out the God-colors in the world.(Matthew 5:14, The Message)
quotes.author: Anonymous,  The Message Remix

quotes.quote: Hurt is a part of life. To be honest, I think hurt is a part of happiness, that our definition of happiness has gotten very narrow lately, very nervous, a little afraid of this brawling, fabulous, unpredictable world.
quotes.author: Julian Gough,  Juno & Juliet

quotes.quote: In the short term, it would make me happy to go play outside. In the long term, it would make me happier to do well at school and become successful. But in the VERY long term, I know which will make better memories.
quotes.author: Bill Watterson,  It's a Magical World

quotes.quote: I liked being a person. I wanted to keep at it.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: I have high blood sugars, and Type 2 diabetes is not going to kill me. But I just have to eat right, and exercise, and lose weight, and watch what I eat, and I will be fine for the rest of my life.
quotes.author: Tom Hanks

quotes.quote: There are two typos of people in this world: those who can edit, and those who can't.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Do nothing, and nothing happens. Life is about decisions. You either make them or they're made for you, but you can't avoid them.
quotes.author: Mhairi McFarlane,  You Had Me At Hello

quotes.quote: Vital lives are about action. You can't feel warmth unless you create it, can't feel delight until you play, can't know serendipity unless you risk.
quotes.author: Joan Erickson

quotes.quote: Accidents don't happen to people who take accidents as a personal insult.
quotes.author: Mario Puzo,  The Godfather

quotes.quote: I didnt pay atteniton to times or distance, instead focusing on how it felt just to be in motion, knowing it wasn't about the finish line but how I got there that mattered.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  The Truth About Forever

quotes.quote: Keep good company, read good books, love good things and cultivate soul and body as faithfully as you can
quotes.author: Louisa May Alcott,  Rose in Bloom

quotes.quote: Never give up on anybody. Miracles happen everyday.
quotes.author: H. Jackson Brown Jr.,  Life's Little Instruction Book: 511 Suggestions, Observations, and Reminders on How to Live a Happy and Rewarding Life

quotes.quote: This is our story to tell. You'd think for all the reading I do, I would have thought about this before, but I haven't. I've never once thought about the interpretative, the story telling aspect of life, of my life. I always felt like I was in a story, yes, but not like I was the author of it, or like I had any say in its telling whatsoever.
quotes.author: Jandy Nelson,  The Sky Is Everywhere

quotes.quote: You know my name, not my story. You've heard what I've done, but not what I've been through.
quotes.author: Jonathan Anthony Burkett,  Neglected But Undefeated

quotes.quote: There are no conditions to which a person cannot grow accustomed, especially if he sees that everyone around him lives in the same way.
quotes.author: Leo Tolstoy,  Anna Karenina

quotes.quote: I love deeply. I love long. I love wide and high. That's right, my love is interdimensional, and my vortex will heal your body and soul.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Sometimes you imagine that everything could have been different for you, that if only you had gone right one day when you chose to go left, you would be living a life you could never have anticipated. But at other times you think there was no other way forward--that you were always bound to end up exactly where you have.
quotes.author: Kevin Brockmeier,  The View from the Seventh Layer

quotes.quote: Dance above the surface of the world. Let your thoughts lift you into creativity that is not hampered by opinion.
quotes.author: Red Haircrow

quotes.quote: I don't see myself being special; I just see myself having more responsibilities than the next man. People look to me to do things for them, to have answers.
quotes.author: Tupac Shakur

quotes.quote: Whether we like it or not, the one justification for the existence of all religions is death, they need death as much as we need bread to eat.
quotes.author: JosÃ© Saramago,  Death with Interruptions

quotes.quote: The friends you make in college are friends you'll have for life, even if you don't talk for years at a time.
quotes.author: Jessica Park,  Flat-Out Love

quotes.quote: You'll forget it when you're dead, and so will I. When I'm dead, I'm going to forget everything-and I advise you to do the same.
quotes.author: Kurt Vonnegut,  Cat's Cradle

quotes.quote: Do you know what you're saying when you say, "Whatever"? It's just a code word for the f-word, followed by "you."And at your age, you never, ever. say that to anyone.' "Blaze leaned back. "So now, when someone says it to me, I just say, 'You too.' (72)
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks

quotes.quote: Fear can only grow in darkness. Once you face fear with light, you win.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: To live only for some future goal is shallow. It's the sides of the mountain that sustain life, not the top.
quotes.author: Robert M. Pirsig

quotes.quote: My mom, Irmelin, taught me the value of life. Her own life was saved by my grandmother during World War II.
quotes.author: Leonardo DiCaprio

quotes.quote: What about the rest of your life?"She shrugged. "What about it?""Aren't you worried about, like, forever?""Forever is composed of nows,"she says.
quotes.author: John Green,  Paper Towns

quotes.quote: Being liked for the way you looked is worse than not being liked at all.
quotes.author: Amanda Hocking,  My Blood Approves

quotes.quote: When I lost her I gained the future, because she was my past, and she freed me to become who I was born to be.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Spend the afternoon, you can't take it with you.
quotes.author: Annie Dillard

quotes.quote: The sunset sky fades from blue to orange over Gainesville, Florida, and what I lost is less than what I gained. I gained love, I lost love, and if could do it all again, I would.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: If one has no sense of humor, one is in trouble.
quotes.author: Betty White,  If You Ask Me

quotes.quote: People who say that yesterday was better than today are ultimately devaluing their own existence.
quotes.author: Karl Lagerfeld

quotes.quote: I believe the way to master my destiny is to serve others. If I raise up others, am I not also raised up?
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: dont be afraid of death, be afraid of the unlived life.
quotes.author: Natalie Babbitt,  Tuck Everlasting

quotes.quote: Atheism, a religion dedicated to its own sense of smug superiority.
quotes.author: Stephen Colbert

quotes.quote: Life is not fair get used to used to it
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: Just because life is hard, and always ends in a bad way, doesn't mean that all stories have to, even if that's what they tell us in school and in the New York Times Review. In fact, it's a good thing that stories are as different as we are, one from another.
quotes.author: James Patterson,  Sundays at Tiffany's

quotes.quote: The lesson will always repeat itself, unless you see yourself as the problem--not others.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: The world is 3 days: As for yesterday, it has vanished along with all that was in it. As for tomorrow, you may never see it. As for today, it is yours, so work on it.
quotes.author: al-Hasan al-Basri

quotes.quote: Life is a succesion of lessons which must be lived to be understood.
quotes.author: Helen Keller

quotes.quote: My only regrets are the moments when i doubted myself and took the safe route. Life is too short to waste time being unhappy.
quotes.author: Dan Howell

quotes.quote: Your heart is the size of an ocean. Go find yourself in its hidden depths.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.quote: Holding this soft, small living creature in my lap this way, though, and seeing how it slept with complete trust in me, I felt a warm rush in my chest. quotes.quote: What made me run away was doubtless not so much the fear of settling down, but of settling down permanently in something ugly.

quotes.quote: Ten long trips around the sun since I last saw that smile, but only joy and thankfulness that on a tiny world in the vastness, for a couple of moments in the immensity of time, we were one.

quotes.quote: Our lives were just beginning, our favorite moment was right now, our favorite songs were unwritten.
quotes.author: Rob Sheffield,  Love Is a Mix Tape

quotes.quote: If children were brought into the world by an act of pure reason alone, would the human race continue to exist? quotes.quote: The ability to discipline yourself to delay gratification in the short term in order to enjoy greater rewards in the long term, is the indispensable prerequisite for success.

quotes.quote: If you haven't confidence in self, you are twice defeated in the race of life. With confidence, you have won even before you have started.

quotes.quote: Freedom is the only worthy goal in life. It is won by disregarding things that lie beyond our control.

quotes.quote: The past can not be cured.

quotes.quote: Restlessness and impatience change nothing except our peace and joy. Peace does not dwell in outward things, but in the heart prepared to wait trustfully and quietly on Him who has all things safely in His hands.

quotes.quote: Your hand can seize today, but not tomorrow; and thoughts of your tomorrow are nothing but desire. Don't waste this breath, if your heart isn't crazy, since "the rest of your life"won't last forever.

quotes.quote: You'd think, 'What if I make a mistake today, I'll regret it'. I don't believe in regret, I feel everything leads us to where we are and we have to just jump forward, mean well, commit and just see what happens.

quotes.quote: Love doesn't make the world go 'round; love is what makes the ride worthwhile.

quotes.quote: there isn't enough of anythingas long as we live. But at intervalsa sweetness appears and, given a chanceprevails.
quotes.author: Raymond Carver,  Ultramarine: Poems

quotes.quote: She said she loved me, and I believed her, because she was looking directly at another man when she said it.

quotes.quote: it always sound scarier when a hollerer talk soft.

quotes.quote: my friends don't seem to be friends at all but people whose phone numbers I haven't lost.
quotes.author: Nick Hornby,  High Fidelity

quotes.quote: Life is a compromise of what your ego wants to do, what experience tells you to do, and what your nerves let you do.
quotes.author: Walter Bagehot

quotes.quote: Despair is the price one pays for setting oneself an impossible aim. It is, one is told, the unforgivable sin, but it is a sin the corrupt or evil man never practices. He always has hope. He never reaches the freezing-point of knowing absolute failure. Only the man of goodwill carries always in his heart this capacity for damnation.
quotes.author: Graham Greene

quotes.quote: I am not my body. My body is nothing without me.
quotes.author: Tom Stoppard,  Rock 'n' Roll

quotes.quote: The Way is not in the sky; the Way is in the heart.
quotes.author: Gautama Buddha

quotes.quote: Inside, I've got a real purist desire and dream about the music. I like the idea of being able to carve out a kind of magical, colourful, artistic, inspirational life. And the reality just turns out to be quite different, working with the business to bring this thing you have created into the world.
quotes.author: Damien Rice

quotes.quote: Mistakes are a part of being human. Appreciate your mistakes for what they are: precious life lessons that can only be learned the hard way. Unless it's a fatal mistake, which, at least, others can learn from.
quotes.author: Al Franken

quotes.quote: Time folds you in its arms and gives you one last kiss, and then it flattens you out and folds you up and tucks you away until it's time for you to become someone else's past time, and then time folds again.
quotes.author: Margaret Atwood,  The Tent

quotes.quote: You will be fine,' the fortune teller says. 'There may be decisions to make and surprises in store. Life takes us to unexpected places sometimes. The future is never set in stone, remember that.
quotes.author: Erin Morgenstern,  The Night Circus

quotes.quote: Knowing it and seeing it are two different things.
quotes.author: Suzanne Collins,  Mockingjay

quotes.quote: I will never deny that life isn't fair. It seems as though when a woman leaves a man she is strong and independent, but when a man leaves a woman he is a pig and a jerk.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: Insanity is often the logic of an accurate mind overtasked. Good mental machinery ought to break its own wheels and levers, if anything is thrust among them suddenly which tends to stop them or reverse their motion. A weak mind does not accumulate force enough to hurt itself; stupidity often saves a man from going mad.
quotes.author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.

quotes.quote: Art and life are subjective. Not everybody's gonna dig what I dig, but I reserve the right to dig it.
quotes.author: Whoopi Goldberg

quotes.quote: I must talk, and you must listen, for we are engaged here in the most important pursuit in history: the search for meaning. What is the nature of being a person? What is the best way to go about being a person? How did we come to be, and what will become of us when we are no longer? In short: What are the rules of this game, and how might we best play it?
quotes.author: John Green,  Looking for Alaska

quotes.quote: If you were all alone in the universe with no one to talk to, no one with which to share the beauty of the stars, to laugh with, to touch, what would be your purpose in life? It is other life; it is love, which gives your life meaning. This is harmony. We must discover the joy of each other, the joy of challenge, the joy of growth.
quotes.author: Mitsugi Saotome

quotes.quote: The heart sees what the eyes do not, and the heart hears what the ears cannot. Sight and sound are vibrations, and so is love.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: When you're the most happening person at the party, it's time to leave
quotes.author: Kelly Cutrone,  If You Have to Cry, Go Outside: And Other Things Your Mother Never Told You

quotes.quote: It's better to have a few faithful friends than numerous shallow friendships.
quotes.author: Jonathan Anthony Burkett,  Friends 2 Lovers: The Unthinkable

quotes.quote: What makes us leave what we love best?What is it inside us that keeps erasing itselfWhen we need it most,That sends us into uncertainty for its own sakeAnd holds us flush there until we begin to love itAnd have to begin again?What is it within our own lives we decline to liveWhenever we find it, making our days unendurable,And nights almost visionless?I still don't know yet, but I do it.
quotes.author: Charles Wright,  Littlefoot: A Poem

quotes.quote: Pack a pillow and blanket and see as much of the world as you can.You will not regret it.
quotes.author: Jhumpa Lahiri,  The Namesake

quotes.quote: Remembering that you are going to die is the best way I know to avoid the trap of thinking you have something to lose.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.quote: I do not think that I will ever reach a stage when I will say, "This is what I believe. Finished."What I believe is alive ... and open to growth
quotes.author: Madeleine L'Engle

quotes.quote: Toby Zeigler: There's literally no one in the world I don't hate right now.
quotes.author: Aaron Sorkin

quotes.quote: I failed to communicate, that's why I chose to leave
quotes.author: Bob Dylan

quotes.quote: Every minute you spend in planning saves 10 minutes in execution; this gives you a 1,000 percent Return on Energy!
quotes.author: Brian Tracy

quotes.quote: In a person's lifetime there may be not more than half a dozen occasions that he can look back to in the certain knowledge that right then, at that moment, there was room for nothing but happiness in his heart.
quotes.author: Ernestine Gilbreth Carey,  Belles on Their Toes

quotes.quote: The rain fluctuates between drizzle and torrential. It messes with your mind. It makes you think things will always be like this, never getting better, always letting you down right when you though the worst was over.
quotes.author: Susane Colasanti,  Waiting for You

quotes.quote: My mother always said 'Don't bother other people.' I think that's good advice.
quotes.author: Amy Sedaris,  I Like You: Hospitality Under the Influence

quotes.quote: Too many locks, not enough keys.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen

quotes.quote: Life itself is simple...it's just not easy.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: I regard the afterlife to be a fairy story for people that are afraid of the dark
quotes.author: Stephen Hawking

quotes.quote: Pretend that every single person you meet has a sign around his or her neck that says, "Make me feel important."Not only will you succeed in sales, you will succeed in life.
quotes.author: Mary Kay Ash

quotes.quote: My imagination can picture no fairer happiness than to continue living for art.
quotes.author: Clara Schumann

quotes.quote: I find Bukowski to be so edgy, gritty, and daring that he oozes romance, and if couples read him in bed they would appreciate what they have.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: A #startup is as fragile as a flower, and it needs a garden and a gardener to help it grow. Those gardens are called Business Incubators.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: When it rains it pours. Maybe the art of life is to convert tough times to great experiences: we can choose to hate the rain or dance in it.
quotes.author: Joan F. Marques

quotes.quote: Most of life is so dull it is not worth discussing, and it is dull at all ages. When we change our brand of cigarette, move to a new neighborhood, subscribe to a different newspaper, fall in and out of love, we are protesting in ways both frivolous and deep against the not to be diluted dullness of day-to-day living.
quotes.author: Truman Capote,  Summer Crossing

quotes.quote: Sometimes I feel that life has passed me by... Do you ever feel that way, Charlie Brown?""I feel that it has knocked me down and walked all over me!
quotes.author: Charles M. Schulz,  The Complete Peanuts, Vol. 5: 1959-1960

quotes.quote: You gotta take chances in this life or you're alreadydead.
quotes.author: Megan McCafferty,  Second Helpings

quotes.quote: If you say that you never lie in life,you honestly insult my intelligence.
quotes.author: Toba Beta,  Master of Stupidity

quotes.quote: I am so grateful for my troubles. As I reflect back on my life, I have come to realize that my greatest triumphs have been born of my greatest troubles.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Nobody ever lives their life all the way up except bullfighters.
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway,  The Sun Also Rises

quotes.quote: The word 'sin' is derived from the Indo-European root 'es-,' meaning 'to be.' When I discovered this etymology, I intuitively understood that for a [person] trapped in patriarchy, which is the religion of the entire planet, 'to be' in the fullest sense is 'to sin'.
quotes.author: Mary Daly

quotes.quote: I always secretly looked forward to nothing going as planned. That way, I wasn't limited by my imagination. That way, anything can, and always did, happen.
quotes.author: CrimethInc.

quotes.quote: Look beyond yourself..
quotes.author: Michael Jackson

quotes.quote: One hand was behind his back, and he held it out, presenting a bouquet of white and smoky purple lilies. 'They're straight from the underworld, by the way. They are everlasting. They won't die.
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  The Devilin Fey

quotes.quote: Poetry is a way of taking life by the throat.
quotes.author: Robert Frost

quotes.quote: You are where you are right now because of the actions you've taken, or maybe, the inaction you've taken.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: I feel very adventurous. There are so many doors to be opened, and I'm not afraid to look behind them.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Taylor

quotes.quote: Hidup hanya ada erti pada yang bahagia.
quotes.author: Hlovate,  Contengan Jalanan

quotes.quote: When your sad--like really sad--you only want to be with other people who are sad.
quotes.author: Nick Hornby,  A Long Way Down

quotes.quote: I curse in cursive. It's hard to read and harder take. But if you take it black, like coffee, then at least it may wake you up to the realities of life.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: So we forgive each other?"The crooked smile climbs up one more time. "Again?"And I look right into his eyes, right into him as far as I can see, because I want him to hear me, I want him to hear me with everything I mean and feel and say."Always,"I say to him. "Every time.
quotes.author: Patrick Ness,  The Ask and the Answer

quotes.quote: You will have five hundred million little bells, and I shall have five hundred million springs of fresh water...
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-ExupÃ©ry,  The Little Prince

quotes.quote: I know I'm an acquired taste - I'm anchovies. And not everybody wants those hairy little things.
quotes.author: Tori Amos

quotes.quote: You know, considering your IQ, you're really socially retarded sometimes.
quotes.author: Shannon Delany,  13 to Life

quotes.quote: Life' wrote a friend of mine, 'is a public performance on the violin, in which you must learn the instrument as you go along.
quotes.author: E.M. Forster,  A Room with a View

quotes.quote: That's the duty of the old, to be anxious on behalf of the young. And the duty of the young is to scorn the anxiety of the old.
quotes.author: Philip Pullman,  The Golden Compass

quotes.quote: My mother was strong, in all the ways I was weak. She fell, she hurt, she felt. She lived. And for all the tumble of her experiences, she still had hope. Maybe this next time would do the trick. Or maybe not. But unless you stepped into the game, you will never know.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  This Lullaby

quotes.quote: The heart is man's treasure, and that's why it's locked in a cage of ribs with only one key. The key isn't metal or material--it's the feeling of love.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Therefore, since we are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us be thankful, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe, for our God is a consuming fire.
quotes.author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: King James Version

quotes.quote: In examining disease, we gain wisdom about anatomy and physiology and biology. In examining the person with disease, we gain wisdom about life.
quotes.author: Oliver Sacks

quotes.quote: Finding happiness should not be seen as finding a needle in a haystack. Happiness is within. Each day is a blessing that brings an abundance of happiness. Therefore, finding happiness should be like finding a gift in a stack of gifts.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Stop giving meaningless praise and start giving meaningful action.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: The thing that's important to know is that you never know. You're always sort of feeling your way.
quotes.author: Diane Arbus,  Diane Arbus: Revelations

quotes.quote: Personally I am very pessimistic. But when, for instance, one of my staff has a baby you can't help but bless them for a good future. Because I can't tell that child, 'Oh, you shouldn't have come into this life.' And yet I know the world is heading in a bad direction. So with those conflicting thoughts in mind, I think about what kind of films I should be making.
quotes.author: Hayao Miyazaki

quotes.quote: Not in his speech, not in his thoughts, I see his greatness, only in his actions, in his life.
quotes.author: Hermann Hesse,  Siddhartha

quotes.quote: Do you realize that all great literature -- "Moby Dick,""Huckleberry Finn,""A Farewell to Arms,""The Scarlet Letter,""The Red Badge of Courage,""The Iliad and The Odyssey,""Crime and Punishment,"the Bible, and "The Charge of the Light Brigade"-- are all about what a bummer it is to be a ...human being?
quotes.author: Kurt Vonnegut

quotes.quote: Learn to drive?""Never,"said Quentin. "My mission in life is to be a passenger.
quotes.author: Diana Wynne Jones,  Archer's Goon

quotes.quote: Whether you like it or not, you are committed to the human endeavor. I cannot ally myself with such a purely negative goal as avoidance of suffering. Suffering is a chance you take by the fact of being alive.
quotes.author: William S. Burroughs,  Letters to Allen Ginsberg, 1953-1957

quotes.quote: The trick to looking ageless is drinking 55 gallons of #FlashBangWowFuzz every 4-6 hours. 24-hour discounts available.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Those guys who want to have the Mohawk...which, to me, is the new business casual.
quotes.author: Gerard Way

quotes.quote: Once you start recognizing the truth of your story, finish the story. It happened but you're still here, you're still capable, powerful, you're not your circumstance. It happened and you made it through. You're still fully equipped with every single tool you need to fulfill your purpose.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: Life is like a ten speed bicycle. Most of us have gears we never use.
quotes.author: Charles M. Schulz

quotes.quote: It takes too much energy to be against something unless it's really important.
quotes.author: Madeleine L'Engle

quotes.quote: if i'm going to fuck up my life, does it really matter which way i do it?.
quotes.author: Jodi Picoult,  Salem Falls

quotes.quote: If you want to be a grocer, or a general, or a politician, or a judge, you will invariably become it; that is your punishment. If you never know what you want to be, if you live what some might call the dynamic life but what I will call the artistic life, if each day you are unsure of who you are and what you know you will never become anything, and that is your reward.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Most of us won't see one another after graduation, and even if we do it will be different. We'll be different. We'll be adults--cured, tagged and labeled and paired and identified and placed neatly on our life path, perfectly round marbles set to roll down even, well-defined slopes.
quotes.author: Lauren Oliver,  Delirium

quotes.quote: We are star stuff harvesting sunlight.
quotes.author: Carl Sagan

quotes.quote: Pray for the dead and fight like hell for the living.
quotes.author: Mary Harris Jones

quotes.quote: The thing is, you can't always have the best of everything. Because for a life to be real, you need it all: good and bad, beach and concrete, the familiar and the unknown, big talkers and small towns.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  The Moon and More

quotes.quote: Temptation is the feeling we get when encountered by an opportunity to do what we innately know we shouldn't.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: Think of the patience God has had for you and let it resonate to others. If you want a more patient world, let patience be your motto
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Desire is half of life; indifference is half of death.
quotes.author: Kahlil Gibran,  Sand and Foam

quotes.quote: A live body and a dead body contain the same number of particles. Structurally, there's no discernible difference. Life and death are unquantifiable abstracts. Why should I be concerned?
quotes.author: Alan Moore,  Watchmen

quotes.quote: I can see it. This one moment when you know you're not a sad story. You're alive. And you stand up and see the lights and the buildings and everything that makes you wonder. And you're listening to that song in that drive with the people you love most in this world. And in this moment I swear... we are infinite.
quotes.author: Stephen Chbosky

quotes.quote: It is our failure to become our perceived ideal that ultimately defines us and makes us unique. It's not easy, but if you accept your misfortune and handle it right your perceived failure can become a catalyst for profound re-invention.
quotes.author: Conan O'Brien

quotes.quote: And I'll tell her that I don't want my life to be samples and scraps. A taste of everything but a meal of nothing.
quotes.author: Ally Condie

quotes.quote: Because if you take a risk, you just might find what you're looking for.
quotes.author: Susane Colasanti,  Take Me There

quotes.quote: ...and you drink a little too much and try a little too hard. And you go home to a cold bed and think, 'That was fine'. And your life is a long line of fine.
quotes.author: Gillian Flynn,  Gone Girl

quotes.quote: When she was a child, my love carried a road-map in her hand the way other girls carried handkerchiefs. She always knew the way. Her feet were little wings. And her beautiful head was a compass.
quotes.author: Roman Payne

quotes.quote: Some people read palms to tell your future, but I read hands to tell your past. Each scar makes a story worth telling. Each callused palm, each cracked knuckle is a missed punch or years in a factory.
quotes.author: Sarah Kay

quotes.quote: The irony of life is that those who wear masks often tell us more truths than those with open faces.
quotes.author: Marie Lu,  The Rose Society

quotes.quote: If you don't want anyone to know about your existence, you might as well kill yourself. You're taking up space, air.
quotes.author: Dave Eggers,  A Heartbreaking Work of Staggering Genius

quotes.quote: Life is fair. We all get the same nine-month shake in the box, and then the dice roll. Some people get a run of sevens. Some people, unfortunately, get snake-eyes. Its just how the world is.
quotes.author: Stephen King,  Full Dark, No Stars

quotes.quote: But life isn't something that should be edited. Life shouldn't be cut. The only way you'll ever discover what it truly means to be alive and human is by sharing the full experience of what it means to be human and each blemish and freckle that comes with it.
quotes.author: Iain Thomas

quotes.quote: Anything that doesn't take years of your life and drive you to suicide hardly seems worth doing.
quotes.author: Cormac McCarthy

quotes.quote: Do not live in the shadow of the masters for ever. Learn to live in the light of your soul. Life deserves full expression.
quotes.author: Amit Ray

quotes.quote: Music is the mediator between the spiritual and the sensual life.
quotes.author: Ludwig van Beethoven

quotes.quote: Life may not be pretty but it's always beautiful. We may only see the ugliness on the surface. The shit that only the world chooses to notice. But, if we dig deep, if we get to the heart of life, where there's no pain or fear, where we can just be who we are and love freely without judgement, it's really beautiful.
quotes.author: S.L. Jennings,  Fear of Falling

quotes.quote: You want to play house, you got to have a job. You want to play very nice house, very sweet house, then you got to have a job you don't like. Great. This is the way ninety-eight-point-nine per cent of the people work things out, so believe me, buddy, you've got nothing to apologize for.
quotes.author: Richard Yates,  Revolutionary Road

quotes.quote: He knew these last lines by heart and mouthed them now in the darkness. My reason for life. Not living, but life. That was the touch. And she was his reason for life, and why he must survive.
quotes.author: Ian McEwan,  Atonement

quotes.quote: Fuck it... That's really the attitude that keeps a family together, it's not "we love each other", it's just "fuck it, man.
quotes.author: Louis C.K.

quotes.quote: Learning the truth has become my life's love.
quotes.author: Dan Brown,  The Da Vinci Code

quotes.quote: There are some choices you can only make once. You can't go back to where you made a choice and then take the other one.
quotes.author: Mary Hoffman,  City of Flowers

quotes.quote: Destiny is a lie. Destiny is justification for atrocity. It is the means by which murderers armour themselves against reprimand. It is a word intended to stand in place of ethics, denying all moral context.
quotes.author: Steven Erikson,  Midnight Tides

quotes.quote: Its important to be comfortable with uncertainty.
quotes.author: Xiaolu Guo

quotes.quote: Maybe getting around in life was nothing but map-reading. A skill that required practice. A key to unlock where you wanted to go. A legend to show where you were.
quotes.author: Justina Chen,  North of Beautiful

quotes.quote: Between living and dreaming there is a third thing. Guess it.
quotes.author: Antonio Machado

quotes.quote: We all like to think the world ends when we do. The truth is our acquaintances, our friends, and our loved ones all live on, and through them, so do we. It's not about what you had, but what you gave. It's not about how you looked, but how you lived. And it's not just about being remembered. It's about giving people a good reason to remember you.
quotes.author: Tonya Hurley,  Ghostgirl

quotes.quote: All life is only a set of pictures in the brain, among which there is no difference betwixt those born of real things and those born of inward dreamings, and no cause to value the one above the other.
quotes.author: H.P. Lovecraft

quotes.quote: You can see the whole entire world in the eyes of a person who knows how to simply stand there and take all of it into him but then you can look into the eyes of someone else and the whole entire world goes away and all that's left is you.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.,  Saint Paul Trois Chateaux: 1948

quotes.quote: I don't know the meaning of life. I don't know why we are here. I think life is full of anxieties and fears and tears. It has a lot of grief in it, and it can be very grim. And I do not want to be the one who tries to tell somebody else what life is all about. To me it's a complete mystery.
quotes.author: Charles M. Schulz,  Charles M. Schulz: Conversations

quotes.quote: You better start swimming, or you'll sink like a stone. Because the Time's they are a-changing.
quotes.author: Bob Dylan

quotes.quote: If someone listens, or stretches out a hand, or whispers a kind word of encouragement, or attempts to understand a lonely person, extraordinary things begin to happen.
quotes.author: Loretta Girzaitis

quotes.quote: That's life for you,"said MacDunn. "Someone always waiting for someone who never comes home. Always someone loving some thing more than that thing loves them. And after a while you want to destroy whatever that thing is, so it can't hurt you no more.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury,  The Fog Horn

quotes.quote: What will be left of all the fearing and wanting associated with your problematic life situation that every day takes up most of your attention? A dash, one or two inches long, between the date of birth and date of death on your gravestone.
quotes.author: Eckhart Tolle

quotes.quote: When we cannot bear to be alone, it means we do not properly value the only companion we will have from birth to death - ourselves.
quotes.author: Eda J. LeShan

quotes.quote: You know how the tightrope guy at the circus wants everyone to believe his act is an art, but deep down you can see that he's really just hoping he makes it all the way across?
quotes.author: Jodi Picoult,  My Sister's Keeper

quotes.quote: Life is hell, at some point we all just have to get used to it.
quotes.author: Alysha Speer,  Sharden

quotes.quote: at your weakest, you end up showing more strength; at your lowest, you are suddenly lifted higher than you've ever been. They all border one another, these opposites and show how quickly we can be altered.
quotes.author: Cecelia Ahern,  Thanks for the Memories

quotes.quote: Waking up is not a selfish pursuit of happiness, it is a revolutionary stance, from the inside out, for the benefit of all beings in existence.
quotes.author: Noah Levine

quotes.quote: Miracles don't happen. You make them happen. They're not wishes or dreams or candles on a cake. They're not impossible. Reality is real. It's totally and completely under my control.
quotes.author: Julie Anne Peters,  Far from Xanadu

quotes.quote: The only real battle in life is between hanging on and letting go.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: In an age of hope men looked up at the night sky and saw 'the heavens."In an age of hopelessness they call it simply 'space.
quotes.author: Peter Kreeft

quotes.quote: Sing your life; any fool can think of words that rhyme.
quotes.author: Morrissey

quotes.quote: I think you don't grow up until you stop worrying about other people's purposes or lack of them and find the purposes you believe in for yourself.
quotes.author: Orson Scott Card,  Xenocide

quotes.quote: I want to state upfront, unequivocally and without doubt: I do not believe that any racial, ethnic or gender group has an advantage in sound judging. I do believe that every person has an equal opportunity to be a good and wise judge, regardless of their background or life experiences.
quotes.author: Sonia Sotomayor

quotes.quote: Yellow flowers are like physical manifestations of sunlight. I'm growing a garden of sunglasses just to help save eyesight and make the world a little bit cooler.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: There're things we keep hidden from one another. Things we hide from ourselves. Things that are kept hidden from us. And things no one knows. You always learn the damnedest things at the worst possible times.
quotes.author: Jim Butcher,  Changes

quotes.quote: Timid men prefer the calm of despotism to the tempestuous sea of Liberty.
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.quote: It was time to take the pumpkin out of the pot and eat it. In the final analysis, that was what solved these big problems of life. You could think and think and get nowhere, but you still had to eat your pumpkin. That brought you down to earth. That gave you a reason for going on. Pumpkin.
quotes.author: Alexander McCall Smith,  The No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency

quotes.quote: Live. How many of us need to be reminded that living has nothing to do with trying to be as good as someone else, or trying to fit into some category, or filling in the blanks on some stupid checklist. That it has nothing to do with punishing yourself for past mistakes.
quotes.author: Suzanne Selfors,  Coffeehouse Angel

quotes.quote: Things Happen and once they start happening you pretty much just to hold on for dear life and see where they drop you when they stop.
quotes.author: Meg Rosoff,  How I Live Now

quotes.quote: Most people gaze neither into the past nor the future; they explore neither truth nor lies. They gaze at the television.
quotes.author: Radiohead

quotes.quote: If you envy successful people, you create a negative force field of attraction that repels you from ever doing the things that you need to do to be successful. If you admire successful people, you create a positive force field of attraction that draws you toward becoming more and more like the kinds of people that you want to be like.
quotes.author: Brian Tracy

quotes.quote: No matter where life takes me, you'll find me with a smile. Presumed to be happy, always laughing like a child. I never thought life could be this sweet! It's got me cheesing from cheek to cheek!
quotes.author: Mac Miller

quotes.quote: Now I'm told this is life, and pain's just a simple compromise.
quotes.author: Hayley Williams

quotes.quote: Windmill or no windmill, he said, life would go on as it had always gone on--that is, badly.
quotes.author: George Orwell,  Animal Farm

quotes.quote: Too many people out there tell us what we can and cannot do but...they don't know who we are, what's put in us.
quotes.author: Alex Rogers,  I'm Only Human After All

quotes.quote: We look into each other's eyes as we shake. His are still full of death and horror, but in them I see my face reflected, and inside my tiny eyes inside his, I think I see some hope.
quotes.author: Ned Vizzini,  It's Kind of a Funny Story

quotes.quote: One of the inescapable encumbrances of leading an interesting life is that there have to be moments when you almost lose it.
quotes.author: Jimmy Buffett,  A Pirate Looks at Fifty

quotes.quote: Love me when I least deserve it, because that's when I really need it.
quotes.author: Swedish Proverb

quotes.quote: I'm not aspiring to be someone else - If I'm me for the rest of my life then so be it
quotes.author: Terry Lander,  Life Through the Eyes of an Insider: 101 Poems to Help You Understand Life Better

quotes.quote: The rule of the universe is that others can do for us what we cannot do for ourselves, and one can paddle every canoe except one's own.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: I had a dream about you last night.. You were balancing ten tiny footballs on your nose while dancing with a turquoise unicorn.
quotes.author: Amy Summers,  I Had a Dream About You

quotes.quote: I have given my word that only death will take me from you.
quotes.author: Philippa Gregory

quotes.quote: Imagination is a quality that was given to man compensate him from whats not. The sense of humor was given to console him from what is.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Hope like that, as I thought before, doesn't make you a weak person. It's hopelessness that makes you weak. Hope makes you stronger, because it brings with it a sense of reason. Not a reason for how or why they were taken from you, but a reason for you to live. Because it's a maybe. A 'maybe someday things won't always be this shit.' And that 'maybe' immediately makes the shittiness better.
quotes.author: Cecelia Ahern,  The Book of Tomorrow

quotes.quote: Forgiveness is not something you do for someone else; it's something you do for yourself. To forgive is not to condone, it is to refuse to continue feeling bad about an injury.
quotes.author: Jim Beaver,  Life's That Way: A Memoir

quotes.quote: The more credit you give away, the more will come back to you. The more you help others, the more they will want to help you.
quotes.author: Brian Tracy

quotes.quote: Life is neither static nor unchanging. With no individuality, there can be no change, no adaptation and, in an inherently changing world, any species unable to adapt is also doomed.
quotes.author: Jean M. Auel

quotes.quote: Don't be disheartened by the forces of evil. Nothing can happen that God hasn't allowed. Even resistance is all part of grand orchestration. The devil always has you right were God wants you.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: For so many years, I couldn't understand why every time I thought that someone finally loved me, like... for real, they would eventually turn to vapor. Every person whom I've ever loved is trapped inside of my chest. I've breathed all of them in so deeply that I've nearly choked and died on every soul that I've ever given myself to.
quotes.author: Jennifer Elisabeth,  Born Ready: Unleash Your Inner Dream Girl

quotes.quote: University can teach you skill and give you opportunity, but it can't teach you sense, nor give you understanding. Sense and understanding are produced within one's soul.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: As we live and as we are, Simplicity - with a capital "S"- is difficult to comprehend nowadays. We are no longer truly simple. We no longer live in simple terms or places. Life is a more complex struggle now. It is now valiant to be simple: a courageous thing to even want to be simple. It is a spiritual thing to comprehend what simplicity means.
quotes.author: Frank Lloyd Wright,  The Natural House

quotes.quote: Still, he figured, sometimes you've got to do what you've got to do, and then sometimes you've just got to run like hell after it's done.
quotes.author: Derek Landy,  Death Bringer

quotes.quote: Know that the same spark of life that is within you, is within all of our animal friends, the desire to live is the same within all of us...
quotes.author: Rai Aren,  Secret of the Sands

quotes.quote: If you have nothing in life but a good friend, you're rich.
quotes.author: Michelle Kwan

quotes.quote: All teachings are mere references. The true experience is living your own life. Then, even the holiest of words are only words.
quotes.author: Ming-Dao Deng

quotes.quote: People see stories everywhere...We take random events and we put them together in a pattern so we can comfort ourselves with a story, no matter how much it obviously isn't true...We have to lie to ourselves to live. Otherwise, we'd go crazy.
quotes.author: Patrick Ness,  More Than This

quotes.quote: But, in her life, nothing was going to happen. Such was the will of God! The future was a dark corridor, and at the far end the door was bolted.
quotes.author: Gustave Flaubert,  Madame Bovary

quotes.quote: Everyone is down on pain, because they forget something important about it: Pain is for the living. Only the dead don't feel it.
quotes.author: Jim Butcher,  White Night

quotes.quote: We are not human beings on a spiritual journey. We are spiritual beings on a human journey.
quotes.author: Stephen R. Covey

quotes.quote: I'm taking all the negatives in my life, and turning them into a positive.
quotes.author: Pitbull

quotes.quote: Always have a sense of humor about life - you'll need it - but always be courteous to boot.
quotes.author: Peter Jennings

quotes.quote: I'm a completely worthless woman and no man should risk his life for me.
quotes.author: Greta Garbo

quotes.quote: Yet if I was asked to do this again - in fact, if I was ever asked to repeat any of my experiences - I'd have to say, fuck it, bring them on. I've no regrets.This is what it means to be alive.
quotes.author: John Barrowman

quotes.quote: Regret is counterproductive. It's looking back on a past that you can't change. Questioning things as they occur can prevent regret in the future.
quotes.author: Colleen Hoover,  Slammed

quotes.quote: All the natural movements of the soul are controlled by laws analogous to those of physical gravity. Grace is the only exception. Grace fills empty spaces, but it can only enter where there is a void to receive it, and it is grace itself which makes this void. The imagination is continually at work filling up all the fissures through which grace might pass.
quotes.author: Simone Weil,  Gravity and Grace

quotes.quote: Life's just a bunch of accidents, connected by one perfect end.
quotes.author: Daniel C. Tomas

quotes.quote: Do not forget that the value and interest of life is not so much to do conspicuous things...as to do ordinary things with the perception of their enormous value.
quotes.author: Pierre Teilhard de Chardin

quotes.quote: I do not cling to life sufficiently to fear death.
quotes.author: Alexandre Dumas,  The Three Musketeers

quotes.quote: In a dog's life, some plaster would fall, some cushions would open, some rugs would shred. Like any relationship, this one had its costs. They were costs we came to accept and balance against the joy and amusement and protection and companionship he gave us.

quotes.quote: The demon that you can swallow gives you its power, and the greater life's pain, the greater life's reply.
quotes.author: Joseph Campbell,  The Power of Myth

quotes.quote: But then, life is a constant withering of possibilities. Some are stolen with the lives of people you love. Others are let go, with regret and reluctance and deep, deep sorrow. But there is compensation for lives unlived in the intoxicating joy of knowing that the life you have - right here, right now - if the one you have chosen. There is power in that, and hope.
quotes.author: Emily Maguire,  Taming the Beast

quotes.quote: I sip my coffee like I fall in love--alone in a field of flowers, writing poetry for the mailman, who delivers love letters, but never gets any.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Never curse a fall. The ground is where humility lives.
quotes.author: Yasmin Mogahed

quotes.quote: Mind is a flexible mirror, adjust it, to see a better world.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Mindfulness : Living in the Moment - Living in the Breath

quotes.quote: Men have had every advantage of us in telling their own story. Education has been theirs in so much higher a degree; the pen has been in their hands. I will not allow books to prove anything.
quotes.author: Jane Austen,  Persuasion

quotes.quote: ...you must always be yourself, and do things at your own pace. Someday, you'll catch up.
quotes.author: Natsuki Takaya

quotes.quote: Cake is happiness! If you know the way of the cake, you know the way of happiness! If you have a cake in front of you, you should not look any further for joy!
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: Life is an experiment in which you may fail or succeed. Explore more, expect least.
quotes.author: Santosh Kalwar

quotes.quote: Life is but a memory Happened long ago. Theatre full of sadness For a long forgotten show.
quotes.author: Nick Drake

quotes.quote: They're animals, all right. But why are you so goddam sure that makes us human beings?
quotes.author: Stephen King,  The Long Walk

quotes.quote: The sky itches and that's why I tickled it with the feather of a bird. Do you realize it's been 14 days since two weeks ago? Boy, time flies.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: The difference between me and other people is that they all walk around with onion skins wrapped around them. Pre-meditations, pretentions, the faces that they present to the world, the faces that they present to themselves.. onion skins that come in layer after layer. They're on the inside of all that. And I... I am the inside of the onion skin walking around. I am only me.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: having nothing to struggleagainstthey have nothing to strugglefor.
quotes.author: Charles Bukowski,  You Get So Alone at Times That it Just Makes Sense

quotes.quote: In this lifetime you're nothing more than you appear to be: a stupid, selfish, ignorant, spoiled little girl who thinks the world lives or dies on whether she gets to go out with some good-looking boy at school...I'd still relish this moment...killing you.
quotes.author: Lauren Kate

quotes.quote: A grateful mindset can set you free from the prison of disempowerment and the shackles of misery.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Without God, life has no purpose, and without purpose, life has no meaning. Without meaning, life has no significance or hope.
quotes.author: Rick Warren,  The Purpose Driven Life: What on Earth Am I Here for?

quotes.quote: I loved how your cheeks had a natural rouge, like a delicate rose, and I was a rogue full of thorns. I was only a flower when I was with you.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: She had coffee-colored eyes, if java were blue-green, and we made love like nobody was watching, which is probably why the audience demanded a refund for our poor performance.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: All of them, all except Phineas, constructed at infinite cost to themselves these Maginot Lines against this enemy they thought they saw across the frontier, this enemy who never attacked that way-if he ever attacked at all; if he was indeed the enemy.
quotes.author: John Knowles,  A Separate Peace

quotes.quote: According to the moral absolutism that characterizes McCandless's beliefs, a challenge in which a successful outcome is assured isn't a challenge at all.
quotes.author: Jon Krakauer,  Into the Wild

quotes.quote: Timing has always been a key element in my life. I have been blessed to have been in the right place at the right time.
quotes.author: Buzz Aldrin

quotes.quote: Every single desire can lead to dream and every single dream has possibility to become reality.
quotes.author: Santosh Kalwar,  Quote Me Everyday

quotes.quote: Allow yourself to enjoy each happy moment in your life.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.author: Charles Bukowski,  You Get So Alone at Times That it Just Makes Sense

quotes.quote: BRODIE:Hell hath no fury like a woman scorned for SEGA.
quotes.author: Kevin Smith

quotes.quote: Life was not to be sitting in hot amorphic leisure in my backyard idly writing or not writing, as the spirit moved me. It was, instead, running madly, in a crowded schedule, in a squirrel cage of busy people. Working, living, dancing, dreaming, talking, kissing- singing, laughing, learning.
quotes.author: Sylvia Plath

quotes.quote: Everything has boundaries. The same holds true with thought. You shouldn't fear boundaries, but you should not be afraid of destroying them. That's what is most important if you want to be free: respect for and exasperation with boundaries.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  Colorless Tsukuru Tazaki and His Years of Pilgrimage

quotes.quote: Rule your mind or it will rule you.
quotes.author: Horace

quotes.quote: It's never overreacting to ask for what you want and need.
quotes.author: Amy Poehler

quotes.quote: Only you can take inner freedom away from yourself, or give it to yourself. Nobody else can.
quotes.author: Michael A. Singer,  The Untethered Soul: The Journey Beyond Yourself

quotes.quote: I have a Rubik's Cube for a heart, and my love for you is no puzzle. Through twists and spins, life can only get more colorful.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: This Valentine's Day rent a poem for your loved. They come in three sizes--small, medium, and romantic. Free refills available to Premium Members.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: I let coffee drip into my mouth the same way I fall in love--slowly, as I wring out my shirt before going to scrub off the 32-ounce spill. I'm as romantic as a free-refill station that's out of sugar, cream, and stirring sticks.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: The wind is my favorite color. It reminds me of the love she painted on my life as she blew past me.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: We must laugh and cry, enjoy and suffer, in a word, vibrate to our full capacity ... I think that's what being really human means.
quotes.author: Gustave Flaubert

quotes.quote: I wanted to cry because I needed you there with me so bad. I knew in that moment that I was in love with you. I was in love with the way you loved me. When you wrapped your arms around me and held me, I knew that no matter what happened with my life, you were my home. You stole the biggest piece of my heart that night.
quotes.author: Colleen Hoover,  Hopeless

quotes.quote: What can we see, read, acquire, but ourselves. Take the book, my friend, and read your eyes out, you will never find there what I find.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: Life lived in the absence of the psychedelic experience that primordial shamanism is based on is life trivialized, life denied, life enslaved to the ego.
quotes.author: Terence McKenna

quotes.quote: Don't stay in bed, unless you can make money in bed.
quotes.author: George Burns

quotes.quote: The truth was, history repeated itself on a daily basis; mistakes were made over and over. People were haunted by what they had done, and by what they hadn't had time to do.
quotes.author: Jodi Picoult

quotes.quote: I had a dream about you last night... you kept meowing at people and licking yourself it was not unlike you normally.
quotes.author: Nicole McKay,  I Had a Dream About You

quotes.quote: The brightest light casts the darkest shadow.
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  The Darker Side of Life

quotes.quote: I was flipping channels, watching this cheerleading program on MTV. They took a field hockey girl and 'transformed' her into a cheerleader by the end of the show. I was just wondering: what if she liked field hockey better?
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  EyeLeash: A Blog Novel

quotes.quote: Men's lives have meaning, not their deaths.
quotes.author: George R.R. Martin,  A Dance with Dragons

quotes.quote: The light at the end of the tunnel is just the light of an oncoming train.
quotes.author: Robert Lowell

quotes.quote: My coffee gets increasingly better the more I drink and the closer I come to the bottom of the cup, where all the sugar is. I wonder if life is the same way as we approach the end.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

quotes.quote: The mind is a wonderful servant, but a terrible master.
quotes.author: Robin S. Sharma

quotes.quote: I tell people not to be afraid of their fears; because their fears are not there to scare them, they're there to let them know that something is worth it. Yet I am often afraid. I guess that means in my life, lots of things have been worth it!
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: Those who don't jump will never fly.
quotes.author: Leena Ahmad Almashat,  Harmony Letters

quotes.quote: Life is hard, and a lot of people come home tired from work. If they're gonna spend half an hour reading, they want some entertainment and a sense of achievement. So that's what I give them. That's all I'm trying to do. Is that really so wrong?
quotes.author: James Patterson

quotes.quote: Life keeps throwing me curve balls and I don't even own a bat. At least my dodging skills are improving.
quotes.author: Jayleigh Cape

quotes.quote: I would not have you descend into your own dream. I would have you be a conscious citizen of this terrible and beautiful world.
quotes.author: Ta-Nehisi Coates,  Between the World and Me

quotes.quote: Happiness has to do with your mindset, not with outside circumstance.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: You can't control what others think. The only thing you can control is yourself. Some people will look down on you for your choices in life, no matter what they are. You can't do anything about that. The only thing you can do is decide how to live your own life. And to hell with everybody else
quotes.author: Marie Sexton

quotes.quote: In the end, perhaps we should simply imagine a joke; a long joke that's continually retold in an accent too thick and strange to ever be completely understood. Life is that joke my friends. The soul is the punch line.
quotes.author: Tom Robbins

quotes.quote: Life is a train that stops at no stations; you either jump abroad or stand on the platform and watch as it passes.
quotes.author: Yasmina Khadra,  Ce que le jour doit Ã  la nuit

quotes.quote: Only the living can read. This means that when I write, my target market is people of the future. Greetings, people of the moon!
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  At even one penny, this book would be overpriced. In fact, free is too expensive, because you'd still waste time by reading it.

quotes.quote: Be happy -- if you're not even happy, what's so good about surviving?
quotes.author: Tom Stoppard,  Rosencrantz and Guildenstern Are Dead

quotes.quote: When you live your life by poor standards, you inflict damage on everyone who crosses your path, especially those you love.
quotes.author: Jordan Belfort

quotes.quote: Bean finds the best apple in our tree and hands it up to me. "You know what this tastes like when you first bite into it?"she asks. "No, what?""Blue sky.""You're zoomed.""You ever eat blue sky?""No,"I admit. "Try it sometime,"she says. "It's apple-flavored.
quotes.author: Rodman Philbrick,  The Last Book in the Universe

quotes.quote: All that is not God is death.
quotes.author: George MacDonald,  Unspoken Sermons: Series I, II, III

quotes.quote: There is nothing more beautiful than a vulnerable heart in open hands.
quotes.author: Amanda Mosher,  Better to be able to love than to be loveable

quotes.quote: A woman made of parts is a dangerous thing. You never know when she'll throw away a piece you may need.
quotes.author: Heidi W. Durrow,  The Girl Who Fell from the Sky

quotes.quote: Like a running blaze on a plain, like a flash of lightning in the clouds. We live in the flicker.
quotes.author: Joseph Conrad,  Heart of Darkness

quotes.quote: Each player must accept the cards life deals him or her; but once they are in hand, he or she alone must decide how to play the cars in order to win the game.
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.quote: The first step in making rabbit stew is catching the rabbit.
quotes.author: Isaac Asimov

quotes.quote: The image isn't reality. Even though we're used to thinking that way alot of the time. We show a kid a picture of a dog and say 'This is a doggie' - but it's not. It's just an image.
quotes.author: L.J. Smith,  The Forbidden Game

quotes.quote: Honey! Bring down a copy of my will - and an eraser!
quotes.author: Woody Allen

quotes.quote: If we are to feel the positive feelings of love, happiness, trust, and gratitude, we periodically also have to feel anger, sadness, fear, and sorrow.
quotes.author: John Gray,  Men Are from Mars, Women Are from Venus

quotes.quote: Some people think football [soccer] is a matter of life and death. I don't like that attitude. I can assure them it is much more serious than that.
quotes.author: Bill Shankly

quotes.quote: Everybody was sorry. Sorry was easy. Sorry was for suckers.
quotes.author: Gretchen McNeil,  Possess

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde,  The Picture of Dorian Gray

quotes.author: Ginnetta Correli

quotes.author: Helen Macdonald,  H is for Hawk

quotes.author: Mitch Albom,  The Five People You Meet in Heaven

The longer she stayed alone out here, the more Tally understood why the Rusties and their predecessors had believed in invisible beings, praying to placate spirits as they trashed the natural world around them.
quotes.author: Scott Westerfeld,  Pretties

quotes.quote: Once you understand how powerful you are within, you exponentially increase the power and potentiality of everything outside of you.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Everything science has taught me strengthens my belief in the continuity of our spiritual existence after death. I believe in an immortal soul. Science has proved that nothing disintegrates into nothingness. Life and soul, therefore, cannot disintegrate into nothingness, and so are immortal.
quotes.author: Werner Von Braun

quotes.quote: Human beings are ultimately nothing but carriers-passageways- for genes. They ride us into the ground like racehorses from generation to generation. quotes.quote: i hope thatwhoever you arewherever you areand no matter howyou are feelingyou will always have somethingto smile about.

quotes.quote: Happiness will grow if you plant the seeds of love in the garden of hope with compassion and care.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: It seems to me that one ought to rejoice in the fact of death-- ought to decide, indeed, to earn one's death by confronting with passion the conundrum of life. quotes.quote: Cheapen words and they'll cheapen you

quotes.quote: No dirt can touch me, like an ocean, everything that comes to me becomes clean.

quotes.quote: Writing blooms flowers for mind, which last forever.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: There is no unmoving mover behind the movement. It is only movement. It is not correct to say that life is moving, but life is movement itself. quotes.quote: It's impossible to walk through solid rock... You have to walk between the molecules that make up the rock.

quotes.quote: Try to be happy within the context of the life we are actually living. Happiness is not a situation to be longed for or a convergence of lucky happenstance. Through the power of our own minds, we can help ourselves.

quotes.author: Thisuri Wanniarachchi

quotes.author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

quotes.quote: And having once chosen, never to seek to return to the crossroads of that decision-for even if one chooses wrongly, the choice cannot be unmade.
quotes.author: Jacqueline Carey,  Kushiel's Chosen

quotes.author: Andy Mulcahy

quotes.author: Jennifer Elisabeth

quotes.quote: All this hoping for nothing-or someone-that's maybe hopeless

quotes.author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

quotes.author: Lisa Cach,  Wake Unto Me

quotes.author: Arthur Conan Doyle,  The Casebook of Sherlock Holmes
